   238→
   239→_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """\
   240→You are maintaining the meta-plan for this codebase. Your goal is to produce
   241→a coherent, prioritized strategy to address ALL open review findings.
   242→
   243→Your plan should:
   244→- Cluster findings by ROOT CAUSE, not by dimension or detector
   245→- Give each cluster (epic) a clear thesis: one imperative sentence
   246→- Order epics by dependency: what must be done first for later work to make sense
   247→- Dismiss findings that don't make sense, are contradictory, or are false positives
   248→- Mark which epics are agent-safe (can be executed mechanically) vs need human judgment
   249→- Avoid creating work that contradicts other work in the plan
   250→- Be ambitious but realistic — aim to resolve all findings coherently
   251→
   252→Available directions for epics: delete, merge, flatten, enforce, simplify, decompose, extract, inline.
   253→
   254→Available plan tools (the agent executing your plan has access to these):
   255→- `desloppify plan queue` — view all items in priority order
   256→- `desloppify plan focus epic/<name>` — focus the queue on one epic
   257→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --permanent --note "why" --attest "..."` — permanently dismiss
   258→- `desloppify plan skip <id> --note "revisit later"` — temporarily defer
   259→- `desloppify plan done <id> --note "what I did" --attest "..."` — mark resolved
   260→- `desloppify plan move <id> top|bottom|before|after <target>` — reorder
   261→- `desloppify plan cluster show <name>` — inspect a cluster
   262→- `desloppify scan` — re-scan after making changes to verify progress
   263→- `desloppify show review --status open` — see all open review findings
   264→
   265→Your output defines the ENTIRE work plan. Findings not assigned to any epic
   266→will remain in the queue as individual items. Dismissed findings will be
   267→removed from the queue with your stated reason.
   268→
   269→Respond with a single JSON object matching this schema:
   270→{
   271→  "strategy_summary": "2-4 sentence narrative: what the meta-plan says, top priorities, current state",
   272→  "epics": [
   273→    {
   274→      "name": "slug-name",
   275→      "thesis": "imperative one-liner",
   276→      "direction": "delete|merge|flatten|enforce|simplify|decompose|extract|inline",
   277→      "root_cause": "why this cluster exists",
   278→      "finding_ids": ["id1", "id2"],
   279→      "dismissed": ["id3"],
   280→      "agent_safe": true,
   281→      "dependency_order": 1,
   282→      "action_steps": ["step 1", "step 2"],
   283→      "status": "pending"
   284→    }
   285→  ],
   286→  "dismissed_findings": [
   287→    {"finding_id": "id", "reason": "why this finding doesn't make sense"}
   288→  ],
   289→  "contradiction_notes": [
   290→    {"kept": "finding_id", "dismissed": "finding_id", "reason": "why"}
   291→  ],
   292→  "priority_rationale": "why the dependency_order is what it is"
   293→}
   294→"""
   295→
   296→
   297→def build_triage_prompt(si: TriageInput) -> str:
   298→    """Build the user-facing prompt content with all finding data."""
   299→    parts: list[str] = []
   300→
   301→    # Section: existing epics
   302→    if si.existing_epics:
   303→        parts.append("## Existing Epics (update these, don't recreate)")
   304→        for name, epic in sorted(si.existing_epics.items()):
   305→            status = epic.get("status", "pending")
   306→            thesis = epic.get("thesis", "")
   307→            direction = epic.get("direction", "")
   308→            fids = epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   309→            parts.append(
   310→                f"- {name} [{status}] ({direction}): {thesis}"
   311→                f"\n  Findings: {', '.join(fids[:10])}"
   312→                f"{'...' if len(fids) > 10 else ''}"
   313→            )
   314→        parts.append("")
   315→
   316→    # Section: what changed
   317→    if si.new_since_last:
   318→        parts.append(f"## New findings since last triage ({len(si.new_since_last)})")
   319→        for fid in sorted(si.new_since_last):
   320→            f = si.open_findings.get(fid, {})
   321→            parts.append(f"- {fid}: {f.get('summary', '(no summary)')}")
   322→        parts.append("")
   323→
   324→    if si.resolved_since_last:
   325→        parts.append(f"## Resolved since last triage ({len(si.resolved_since_last)})")
   326→        for fid in sorted(si.resolved_since_last):
   327→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   328→        parts.append("")
   329→
   330→    # Section: all open review findings
   331→    parts.append(f"## All open review findings ({len(si.open_findings)})")
   332→    for fid, f in sorted(si.open_findings.items()):
   333→        detail = f.get("detail", {}) if isinstance(f.get("detail"), dict) else {}
   334→        suggestion = detail.get("suggestion", "")
   335→        dimension = detail.get("dimension", "")
   336→        confidence = f.get("confidence", "medium")
   337→        file_path = f.get("file", "")
   338→        summary = f.get("summary", "")
   339→        parts.append(f"- [{confidence}] {fid}")
   340→        parts.append(f"  File: {file_path}")
   341→        if dimension:
   342→            parts.append(f"  Dimension: {dimension}")
   343→        parts.append(f"  Summary: {summary}")
   344→        if suggestion:
   345→            parts.append(f"  Suggestion: {suggestion}")
   346→    parts.append("")
   347→
   348→    # Section: dimension scores for context
   349→    if si.dimension_scores:
   350→        parts.append("## Dimension scores (context)")
   351→        for name, data in sorted(si.dimension_scores.items()):
   352→            if isinstance(data, dict):
   353→                score = data.get("score", "?")
   354→                strict = data.get("strict", score)
   355→                issues = data.get("issues", 0)
   356→                parts.append(f"- {name}: {score}% (strict: {strict}%, {issues} issues)")
   357→        parts.append("")
   358→
   359→    # Section: previously dismissed
   360→    if si.previously_dismissed:
   361→        parts.append(f"## Previously dismissed ({len(si.previously_dismissed)})")
   362→        parts.append("Maintain unless contradicted by new evidence.")
   363→        for fid in si.previously_dismissed:
   364→            parts.append(f"- {fid}")
   365→        parts.append("")
   366→
   367→    return "\n".join(parts)
   368→
   369→
   370→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   371→# Result parsing
   372→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   373→
   374→def parse_triage_result(raw: dict, valid_ids: set[str]) -> TriageResult:
   375→    """Parse and validate raw LLM output into a TriageResult.
   376→
   377→    Invalid finding IDs are silently dropped from epics and dismissals.
   378→    """
   379→    strategy_summary = str(raw.get("strategy_summary", ""))
   380→
   381→    epics: list[dict] = []
   382→    for raw_epic in raw.get("epics", []):
   383→        if not isinstance(raw_epic, dict):
   384→            continue
   385→        name = str(raw_epic.get("name", "")).strip()
   386→        if not name:
   387→            continue
   388→        # Validate direction
   389→        direction = str(raw_epic.get("direction", "simplify")).strip()
   390→        if direction not in VALID_EPIC_DIRECTIONS:
   391→            direction = "simplify"
   392→        # Filter to valid finding IDs
   393→        finding_ids = [
   394→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("finding_ids", [])
   395→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   396→        ]
   397→        dismissed = [
   398→            fid for fid in raw_epic.get("dismissed", [])
   399→            if isinstance(fid, str) and fid in valid_ids
   400→        ]
   401→        action_steps = [
   402→            str(s) for s in raw_epic.get("action_steps", [])
   403→            if isinstance(s, str)
   404→        ]
   405→
   406→        epics.append({
   407→            "name": name,
   408→            "thesis": str(raw_epic.get("thesis", "")),
   409→            "direction": direction,
   410→            "root_cause": str(raw_epic.get("root_cause", "")),
   411→            "finding_ids": finding_ids,
   412→            "dismissed": dismissed,
   413→            "agent_safe": bool(raw_epic.get("agent_safe", False)),
   414→            "dependency_order": int(raw_epic.get("dependency_order", 999)),
   415→            "action_steps": action_steps,
   416→            "status": str(raw_epic.get("status", "pending")),
   417→        })
   418→
   419→    dismissed_findings: list[DismissedFinding] = []
   420→    for d in raw.get("dismissed_findings", []):
   421→        if not isinstance(d, dict):
   422→            continue
   423→        fid = str(d.get("finding_id", ""))
   424→        if fid in valid_ids:
   425→            dismissed_findings.append(
   426→                DismissedFinding(finding_id=fid, reason=str(d.get("reason", "")))
   427→            )
   428→
   429→    contradiction_notes: list[ContradictionNote] = []
   430→    for c in raw.get("contradiction_notes", []):
   431→        if not isinstance(c, dict):
   432→            continue
   433→        contradiction_notes.append(ContradictionNote(
   434→            kept=str(c.get("kept", "")),
   435→            dismissed=str(c.get("dismissed", "")),
   436→            reason=str(c.get("reason", "")),
   437→        ))
   438→
   439→    priority_rationale = str(raw.get("priority_rationale", ""))
   440→
   441→    return TriageResult(
   442→        strategy_summary=strategy_summary,
   443→        epics=epics,
   444→        dismissed_findings=dismissed_findings,
   445→        contradiction_notes=contradiction_notes,
   446→        priority_rationale=priority_rationale,
   447→    )
   448→
   449→
   450→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   451→# Plan mutation
   452→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   453→
   454→def apply_triage_to_plan(
   455→    plan: PlanModel,
   456→    state: StateModel,
   457→    triage: TriageResult,
   458→    *,
   459→    trigger: str = "manual",
   460→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   461→    """Apply parsed triage result to the living plan.
   462→
   463→    1. Creates/updates triage-clusters in plan["clusters"]
   464→    2. Marks dismissed findings as triaged_out skips
   465→    3. Reorders queue_order to group epic members by dependency_order
   466→    4. Updates epic_triage_meta with snapshot hash
   467→    """
   468→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   469→    now = utc_now()
   470→    result = TriageMutationResult()
   471→    result.strategy_summary = triage.strategy_summary
   472→
   473→    clusters = plan["clusters"]
   474→    skipped: dict = plan["skipped"]
   475→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   476→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   477→    version = int(meta.get("version", 0)) + 1
   478→    result.triage_version = version
   479→
   480→    # --- Update/create triage-clusters ------------------------------------
   481→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   482→        raw_name = epic_data["name"]
   483→        epic_name = f"{EPIC_PREFIX}{raw_name}" if not raw_name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX) else raw_name
   484→
   485→        existing = clusters.get(epic_name)
   486→        if existing and existing.get("thesis"):
   487→            # Update existing triage-cluster
   488→            existing["thesis"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   489→            existing["direction"] = epic_data["direction"]
   490→            existing["root_cause"] = epic_data.get("root_cause", "")
   491→            existing["finding_ids"] = epic_data["finding_ids"]
   492→            existing["dismissed"] = epic_data.get("dismissed", [])
   493→            existing["agent_safe"] = epic_data.get("agent_safe", False)
   494→            existing["dependency_order"] = epic_data["dependency_order"]
   495→            existing["action_steps"] = epic_data.get("action_steps", [])
   496→            existing["updated_at"] = now
   497→            existing["triage_version"] = version
   498→            existing["description"] = epic_data["thesis"]
   499→            # Don't overwrite in_progress status from agent
   500→            if existing.get("status") != "in_progress":
   501→                existing["status"] = epic_data.get("status", "pending")
   502→            result.epics_updated += 1
   503→        else:
   504→            # Create new triage-cluster
   505→            cluster: Cluster = {
   506→                "name": epic_name,
   507→                "description": epic_data["thesis"],
   508→                "finding_ids": epic_data["finding_ids"],
   509→                "auto": True,
   510→                "cluster_key": f"epic::{epic_name}",
   511→                "action": f"desloppify plan focus {epic_name}",
   512→                "user_modified": False,
   513→                "created_at": now,
   514→                "updated_at": now,
   515→                # Epic fields
   516→                "thesis": epic_data["thesis"],
   517→                "direction": epic_data["direction"],
   518→                "root_cause": epic_data.get("root_cause", ""),
   519→                "supersedes": [],
   520→                "dismissed": epic_data.get("dismissed", []),
   521→                "agent_safe": epic_data.get("agent_safe", False),
   522→                "dependency_order": epic_data["dependency_order"],
   523→                "action_steps": epic_data.get("action_steps", []),
   524→                "source_clusters": [],
   525→                "status": epic_data.get("status", "pending"),
   526→                "triage_version": version,
   527→            }
   528→            clusters[epic_name] = cluster
   529→            result.epics_created += 1
   530→
   531→    # --- Dismiss findings ---------------------------------------------------
   532→    dismissed_ids: list[str] = []
   533→    for df in triage.dismissed_findings:
   534→        fid = df.finding_id
   535→        dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   536→        # Remove from queue, add to skipped as triaged_out
   537→        if fid in order:
   538→            order.remove(fid)
   539→        skipped[fid] = {
   540→            "finding_id": fid,
   541→            "kind": "triaged_out",
   542→            "reason": df.reason,
   543→            "note": f"Dismissed by epic triage v{version}",
   544→            "attestation": None,
   545→            "created_at": now,
   546→            "review_after": None,
   547→            "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   548→        }
   549→        result.findings_dismissed += 1
   550→
   551→    # Also handle per-epic dismissed lists
   552→    for epic_data in triage.epics:
   553→        for fid in epic_data.get("dismissed", []):
   554→            if fid not in dismissed_ids and fid in order:
   555→                order.remove(fid)
   556→                dismissed_ids.append(fid)
   557→                skipped[fid] = {
   558→                    "finding_id": fid,
   559→                    "kind": "triaged_out",
   560→                    "reason": f"Dismissed by epic triage v{version}",
   561→                    "note": None,
   562→                    "attestation": None,
   563→                    "created_at": now,
   564→                    "review_after": None,
   565→                    "skipped_at_scan": int(state.get("scan_count", 0)),
   566→                }
   567→                result.findings_dismissed += 1
   568→
   569→    # --- Reorder queue: epic findings grouped by dependency_order -----------
   570→    epic_finding_ids: set[str] = set()
   571→    epic_ordered_ids: list[str] = []
   572→    for epic_data in sorted(triage.epics, key=lambda e: e.get("dependency_order", 999)):
   573→        for fid in epic_data["finding_ids"]:
   574→            if fid not in epic_finding_ids and fid not in dismissed_ids:
   575→                epic_finding_ids.add(fid)
   576→                epic_ordered_ids.append(fid)
   577→
   578→    # Rebuild order: epic items first (by dependency), then non-epic items in original order
   579→    non_epic_items = [fid for fid in order if fid not in epic_finding_ids]
   580→    # Insert epic items at the front.
   581→    new_order: list[str] = []
   582→    new_order.extend(epic_ordered_ids)
   583→    new_order.extend(non_epic_items)
   584→    order.clear()
   585→    order.extend(new_order)
   586→
   587→    # --- Update triage meta -----------------------------------------------
   588→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   589→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   590→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   591→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   592→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   593→    )
   594→
   595→    plan["epic_triage_meta"] = {
   596→        "triaged_ids": open_review_ids,
   597→        "last_run": now,
   598→        "version": version,
   599→        "dismissed_ids": dismissed_ids,
   600→        "finding_snapshot_hash": current_hash,
   601→        "strategy_summary": triage.strategy_summary,
   602→        "trigger": trigger,
   603→    }
   604→    plan["updated"] = now
   605→
   606→    return result
   607→
   608→
   609→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   610→# Top-level orchestrator
   611→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   612→
   613→@dataclass
   614→class TriageDeps:
   615→    """Injectable dependencies for the triage engine."""
   616→
   617→    llm_call: Any = None  # Callable[[str, str], str] — (system, user) -> response
   618→
   619→
   620→def triage_epics(
   621→    plan: PlanModel,
   622→    state: StateModel,
   623→    *,
   624→    deps: TriageDeps | None = None,
   625→    dry_run: bool = False,
   626→    trigger: str = "manual",
   627→) -> TriageMutationResult:
   628→    """Run epic triage: collect input, call LLM, apply results.
   629→
   630→    If ``dry_run`` is True, collects input and builds prompt but does not
   631→    call the LLM or mutate the plan.
   632→
   633→    If ``deps.llm_call`` is None, returns a dry-run result with the prompt.
   634→    """
   635→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   636→    si = collect_triage_input(plan, state)
   637→
   638→    prompt = build_triage_prompt(si)
   639→    valid_ids = set(si.open_findings.keys())
   640→
   641→    if dry_run or deps is None or deps.llm_call is None:
   642→        result = TriageMutationResult(dry_run=True)
   643→        result.strategy_summary = f"[dry-run] Prompt built with {len(si.open_findings)} findings"
   644→        return result
   645→
   646→    # Call LLM
   647→    try:
   648→        raw_response = deps.llm_call(_TRIAGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, prompt)
   649→        raw_json = json.loads(raw_response)
   650→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   651→        logger.error("Epic triage LLM response parse error: %s", exc)
   652→        result = TriageMutationResult()
   653→        result.strategy_summary = f"Triage failed: {exc}"
   654→        return result
   655→
   656→    triage = parse_triage_result(raw_json, valid_ids)
   657→    return apply_triage_to_plan(plan, state, triage, trigger=trigger)
   658→
   659→
   660→__all__ = [
   661→    "DismissedFinding",
   662→    "FINDING_ID_RE",
   663→    "TriageDeps",
   664→    "TriageInput",
   665→    "TriageMutationResult",
   666→    "TriageResult",
   667→    "apply_triage_to_plan",
   668→    "build_triage_prompt",
   669→    "collect_triage_input",
   670→    "detect_recurring_patterns",
   671→    "extract_finding_citations",
   672→    "last_real_review_timestamp",
   673→    "parse_triage_result",
   674→    "triage_epics",
   675→]
   676→

   433→def _fixer_help_lines(langs: list[str]) -> list[str]:
   434→    fixer_help_lines: list[str] = []
   435→    for lang_name in langs:
   436→        try:
   437→            fixer_names = sorted(get_lang(lang_name).fixers.keys())
   438→        except (ImportError, ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError):
   439→            fixer_names = []
   440→        fixer_list = ", ".join(fixer_names) if fixer_names else "none yet"
   441→        fixer_help_lines.append(f"fixers ({lang_name}): {fixer_list}")
   442→    fixer_help_lines.append("special: review — prepare structured review data")
   443→    return fixer_help_lines
   444→

   454→    p_fix.add_argument("--state", type=str, default=None, help="Path to state file")
   455→    p_fix.add_argument(

   462→def _add_plan_parser(sub) -> None:
   463→    p_plan = sub.add_parser(
   464→        "plan",
   465→        help="Living plan: generate, reorder, cluster, skip, note",
   466→        description="""\
   467→Manage the living plan — a persistent layer on top of the work queue.
   468→Track custom ordering, clusters, skips, and per-finding annotations.
   469→Run with no subcommand to generate a full prioritized markdown plan.""",
   470→        epilog="""\
   471→typical workflow:
   472→  desloppify scan                       # detect findings
   473→  desloppify plan                       # full prioritized markdown
   474→  desloppify plan queue                 # compact table of all items
   475→  desloppify plan cluster create ...    # group related findings
   476→  desloppify plan focus <cluster>       # narrow scope
   477→  desloppify next                       # work on the next item
   478→  desloppify plan done <id> --attest .. # mark as fixed
   479→
   480→patterns (used by move, skip, done, describe, note, etc.):
   481→  Patterns match findings by detector, file, ID prefix, glob, or name.
   482→  Cluster names also work as patterns — they expand to all member IDs.
   483→  Examples: "security", "src/foo.py", "unused::*React*", "my-cluster"
   484→
   485→subcommands:
   486→  show       Show plan metadata summary
   487→  queue      Compact table of upcoming queue items
   488→  reset      Reset plan to empty
   489→  move       Move findings or clusters in the queue
   490→  done       Mark findings as fixed (score movement + next-step)
   491→  describe   Set augmented description
   492→  note       Set note on findings
   493→  skip       Skip findings (temporary/permanent/false_positive)
   494→  unskip     Bring skipped findings back to queue
   495→  reopen     Reopen resolved findings
   496→  focus      Set or clear active cluster focus
   497→  cluster    Manage finding clusters
   498→  triage     Staged triage workflow (after review)""",
   499→        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,
   500→    )
   501→    p_plan.add_argument("--state", type=str, default=None, help="Path to state file")
   502→    p_plan.add_argument(
   503→        "--output", type=str, metavar="FILE", help="Write to file instead of stdout"
   504→    )
   505→
   506→    plan_sub = p_plan.add_subparsers(dest="plan_action")
   507→
   508→    # plan show
   509→    plan_sub.add_parser("show", help="Show plan metadata summary")
   510→
   511→    # plan queue
   512→    p_queue = plan_sub.add_parser("queue", help="Compact table of upcoming queue items")
   513→    p_queue.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=30, help="Max items (default: 30, 0=all)")
   514→    p_queue.add_argument("--cluster", type=str, default=None, metavar="NAME",
   515→                         help="Filter to a specific cluster")
   516→    p_queue.add_argument("--include-skipped", action="store_true",
   517→                         help="Include skipped items at end")
   518→    p_queue.add_argument("--sort", choices=["priority", "recent"], default="priority",
   519→                         help="Sort order (default: priority)")
   520→
   521→    # plan reset
   522→    plan_sub.add_parser("reset", help="Reset plan to empty")
   523→
   524→    # plan move <patterns> <position> [--target TARGET]
   525→    p_move = plan_sub.add_parser(
   526→        "move",
   527→        help="Move findings in the queue",
   528→        epilog="""\
   529→patterns accept finding IDs, detector names, file paths, globs, or cluster names.
   530→cluster names expand to all member IDs automatically.
   531→
   532→examples:
   533→  desloppify plan move security top                         # all findings from detector
   534→  desloppify plan move "unused::src/foo.ts::*" top          # glob pattern
   535→  desloppify plan move smells bottom                        # deprioritize
   536→  desloppify plan move my-cluster top                       # cluster members
   537→  desloppify plan move my-cluster unused top                # mix clusters + findings
   538→  desloppify plan move unused before -t security            # before a finding/cluster
   539→  desloppify plan move smells after -t my-cluster           # after a cluster
   540→  desloppify plan move security up -t 3                     # shift up 3 positions""",
   541→        formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter,

   549→        help="Where to move",

   551→    p_move.add_argument(
   552→        "-t", "--target", default=None,

   619→    p_done = plan_sub.add_parser(
   620→        "done",

   622→        epilog="""\
   623→examples:

   720→    def _add_triage_flags(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
   721→        parser.add_argument(

   736→        parser.add_argument(
   737→            "--strategy", type=str, default=None,

   740→        parser.add_argument(

   744→        parser.add_argument(
   745→            "--note", type=str, default=None,

   748→        parser.add_argument(
   749→            "--start", action="store_true", default=False,

   752→        parser.add_argument(
   753→            "--confirm",
   754→            type=str,
   755→            choices=["observe", "reflect", "organize"],
   756→            default=None,
   757→            help="Confirm a completed stage (shows summary, requires --attestation)",

   759→        parser.add_argument(

   764→        )
   765→        parser.add_argument(

   771→        parser.add_argument(

   773→            help="Preview mode",

   818→def _add_dev_parser(sub) -> None:
   819→    p_dev = sub.add_parser("dev", help="Developer utilities")
   820→    dev_sub = p_dev.add_subparsers(dest="dev_action", required=True)
   821→    d_scaffold = dev_sub.add_parser(
   822→        "scaffold-lang", help="Generate a standardized language plugin scaffold"

   824→    d_scaffold.add_argument("name", type=str, help="Language name (snake_case)")
   825→    d_scaffold.add_argument(

    63→def _inject_triage_stages(plan: dict) -> None:
    64→    """Inject all 4 triage stage IDs into the queue (fresh start)."""
    65→    order: list[str] = plan.setdefault("queue_order", [])

   200→def _print_progress(plan: dict, open_findings: dict) -> None:
   201→    """Show cluster state and unclustered findings."""

   206→        if c.get("finding_ids")

   211→            count = len(cluster.get("finding_ids", []))
   212→            desc = cluster.get("description") or ""
   213→            steps = cluster.get("action_steps", [])
   214→            auto = cluster.get("auto", False)

   234→    unclustered = [fid for fid in open_findings if fid not in all_clustered]
   235→    if unclustered:

   240→            short = short_finding_id(fid)

   242→        if len(unclustered) > 10:

   244→    elif open_findings:
   245→        organized, total, _ = _triage_coverage(plan, open_review_ids=set(open_findings.keys()))

   249→def _apply_completion(args: argparse.Namespace, plan: dict, strategy: str) -> None:
   250→    """Shared completion logic: update meta, remove triage::pending, save."""
   251→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   252→    state = runtime.state
   253→
   254→    organized, total, clusters = _triage_coverage(
   255→        plan, open_review_ids=_open_review_ids_from_state(state),
   256→    )
   257→
   258→    # Purge all triage stage IDs.
   259→    purge_ids(plan, list(TRIAGE_IDS))
   260→
   261→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   262→
   263→    meta = plan.setdefault("epic_triage_meta", {})
   264→    meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   265→    open_review_ids = sorted(
   266→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   267→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   268→    )
   269→    meta["triaged_ids"] = open_review_ids
   270→    if strategy.strip().lower() != "same":
   271→        meta["strategy_summary"] = strategy
   272→    meta["trigger"] = "manual_triage"
   273→    meta["last_completed_at"] = utc_now()
   274→    # Archive stages before clearing so previous analysis is preserved
   275→    stages = meta.get("triage_stages", {})
   276→    if stages:
   277→        meta["last_triage"] = {
   278→            "completed_at": utc_now(),
   279→            "stages": {k: dict(v) for k, v in stages.items()},
   280→            "strategy": strategy if strategy.strip().lower() != "same" else meta.get("strategy_summary", ""),
   281→        }
   282→    meta["triage_stages"] = {}  # clear stages on completion
   283→    meta.pop("stage_refresh_required", None)
   284→    meta.pop("stage_snapshot_hash", None)
   285→
   286→    save_plan(plan)
   287→
   288→    cluster_count = len([c for c in clusters.values() if c.get("finding_ids")])
   289→    print(colorize(f"  Triage complete: {organized}/{total} findings in {cluster_count} cluster(s).", "green"))
   290→    effective_strategy = strategy if strategy.strip().lower() != "same" else meta.get("strategy_summary", "")
   291→    if effective_strategy:
   292→        print(colorize(f"  Strategy: {effective_strategy}", "cyan"))
   293→    print(colorize("  Run `desloppify next` to start implementation.", "green"))
   294→

   301→    """Record the OBSERVE stage: agent analyses themes and root causes.
   302→
   303→    No citation gate — the point is genuine analysis, not ID-stuffing.
   304→    Just requires a 100-char report describing what the agent observed.
   305→    """

Flags production files missing or with stale design reviews. **SPLIT** — Has cleanly separable phases:

Builds a generic language plugin from tool specs. **SKIP** — Linear assembly pipeline: normalize specs → register detectors → check tree-sitter → build phases → create config. No independent logic; each step depends on prior results. Splitting would just scatter config assembly.

    16→def scan_queue_preflight(args) -> None:
    17→    """Warn and gate scan when queue has unfinished items."""
    18→    # CI profile always passes
    19→    if getattr(args, "profile", None) == "ci":
    20→        return
    21→
    22→    # --force-rescan with valid attestation bypasses
    23→    if getattr(args, "force_rescan", False):
    24→        attest = getattr(args, "attest", None) or ""
    25→        if "i understand" not in attest.lower():
    26→            print(
    27→                colorize(
    28→                    '  --force-rescan requires --attest "I understand this is not '
    29→                    "the intended workflow and I am intentionally skipping queue "
    30→                    'completion"',
    31→                    "red",
    32→                ),
    33→                file=sys.stderr,
    34→            )
    35→            sys.exit(1)
    36→        print(
    37→            colorize(
    38→                "  --force-rescan: bypassing queue completion check. "
    39→                "Plan-start score will be reset.",
    40→                "yellow",
    41→            )
    42→        )
    43→        # Clear plan_start_scores
    44→        try:
    45→            plan = load_plan()
    46→            if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
    47→                plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
    48→                save_plan(plan)
    49→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
    50→            logging.debug("Plan score cleanup skipped: %s", exc)
    51→        return
    52→
    53→    # No plan = no gate (first scan, or user never uses plan)
    54→    try:
    55→        plan = load_plan()
    56→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    57→        return
    58→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
    59→        return  # No active cycle
    60→
    61→    # Count plan-aware remaining items
    62→    try:
    63→        state = state_mod.load_state(state_path(args))
    64→        remaining = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan)
    65→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS:
    66→        return
    67→    if remaining == 0:
    68→        return  # Queue clear, scan allowed
    69→
    70→    # GATE
    71→    print(
    72→        colorize(
    73→            f"\n  WARNING: {remaining} item{'s' if remaining != 1 else ''}"
    74→            " remaining in your queue.",
    75→            "red",
    76→        ),
    77→        file=sys.stderr,
    78→    )
    79→    print(
    80→        colorize(

    82→            "red",
    83→        ),
    84→        file=sys.stderr,
    85→    )
    86→    print(
    87→        colorize(
    88→            "  Work through items with `desloppify next`, then scan when clear.",
    89→            "dim",
    90→        ),
    91→        file=sys.stderr,
    92→    )
    93→    print(
    94→        colorize(
    95→            "\n  To force a rescan (resets your plan-start score):",
    96→            "dim",
    97→        ),
    98→        file=sys.stderr,
    99→    )
   100→    print(
   101→        colorize(
   102→            '    desloppify scan --force-rescan --attest "I understand this is not '

    20→def _consecutive_subjective_integrity_status(state: dict, status: str) -> int:
    21→    """Return consecutive trailing scans with the given subjective-integrity status."""
    22→    history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    23→    if not isinstance(history, list):
    24→        return 0
    25→
    26→    streak = 0
    27→    for entry in reversed(history):
    28→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
    29→            break
    30→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
    31→        if not isinstance(integrity, dict):
    32→            break
    33→        if integrity.get("status") != status:
    34→            break
    35→        streak += 1
    36→    return streak
    37→
    38→
    39→def _show_score_reveal(
    40→    state: dict,
    41→    new: state_mod.ScoreSnapshot,
    42→    *,
    43→    target_strict: float | None = None,
    44→) -> None:
    45→    """Show before/after score comparison when a queue cycle just completed.
    46→
    47→    This fires when the plan had ``plan_start_scores`` and the queue was empty
    48→    at scan time (i.e. the reconcile block cleared plan_start_scores).  We detect
    49→    this by checking the plan *before* the clear happened — since merge_scan_results
    50→    clears it, we peek at the ``_last_score_reveal`` stash it leaves behind.
    51→    """
    52→    # scan_workflow stashes the old plan_start_scores on state as a transient
    53→    # key when it clears them (queue empty).  Pop it here for the reveal.
    54→    plan_start = state.pop("_plan_start_scores_for_reveal", None)
    55→    if not isinstance(plan_start, dict) or not plan_start.get("strict"):
    56→        return
    57→
    58→    old_strict = float(plan_start["strict"])
    59→    new_strict = float(new.strict or 0)
    60→    delta = round(new_strict - old_strict, 1)
    61→    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
    62→
    63→    bar = "=" * 50
    64→    print(colorize(f"  {bar}", "cyan"))
    65→    print(colorize("  SCORE UPDATE — Queue cycle complete!", "bold"))
    66→    print(colorize(f"  Plan-start: strict {old_strict:.1f}/100", "dim"))
    67→    print(colorize(f"  Updated:    strict {new_strict:.1f}/100{delta_str}", "cyan"))
    68→    if target_strict is not None:
    69→        target_gap = round(target_strict - new_strict, 1)

    72→        else:
    73→            print(colorize(f"  Target:     {target_strict:.1f} — reached!", "green"))
    74→    print(colorize(f"  {bar}", "cyan"))

    84→    if diff["reopened"]:

    97→        )

    99→
   100→def show_score_delta(
   101→    state: dict,
   102→    prev_overall: float | None,
   103→    prev_objective: float | None,
   104→    prev_strict: float | None,

   133→    strict_delta_str, strict_color = format_delta(new.strict, prev_strict)
   134→    verified_delta_str, verified_color = format_delta(new.verified, prev_verified)
   135→    print(

   138→        + colorize(

   143→        + colorize(

   150→    # Surface wontfix debt gap prominently when significant
   151→    wontfix = stats.get("wontfix", 0)
   152→    gap = (new.overall or 0) - (new.strict or 0)
   153→    if gap >= 5 and wontfix >= 10:

   167→        print(colorize("    objective = mechanical detectors only (no subjective review)", "dim"))
   168→        print(colorize("    strict   = like overall, but wontfix counts against you  <-- your north star", "dim"))

   171→    # Show strict target progress

   174→
   175→    integrity = state.get("subjective_integrity", {})
   176→    if isinstance(integrity, dict):

   108→        )
   109→    return bool(recon.changes)

   112→def _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, sync_fn) -> bool:
   113→    """Sync unscored subjective dimensions into the plan queue."""
   114→    sync = sync_fn(plan, state)
   115→    if sync.injected:
   116→        print(
   117→            colorize(
   118→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.injected)} unscored subjective dimension(s) queued for initial review.",
   119→                "cyan",
   120→            )
   121→        )
   122→    return bool(sync.changes)

   125→def _sync_stale_dimensions(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, sync_fn) -> bool:
   126→    """Sync stale subjective dimensions (prune refreshed + inject stale) in plan queue."""
   127→    sync = sync_fn(plan, state)
   128→    if sync.pruned:
   129→        print(
   130→            colorize(
   131→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.pruned)} refreshed subjective dimension(s) removed from queue.",
   132→                "cyan",
   133→            )
   134→        )
   135→    if sync.injected:
   136→        print(
   137→            colorize(
   138→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.injected)} stale subjective dimension(s) queued for refresh.",
   139→                "cyan",
   140→            )
   141→        )
   142→    return bool(sync.changes)

   145→def _sync_auto_clusters(
   146→    plan: dict[str, object],
   147→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   148→    *,
   149→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
   150→) -> bool:
   151→    """Regenerate automatic task clusters after scan merge."""
   152→    return bool(auto_cluster_findings(plan, state, target_strict=target_strict))

   155→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:
   156→    """Set plan_start_scores when beginning a new queue cycle."""
   157→    if plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   158→        return False
   159→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   160→    if scores.strict is None:
   161→        return False
   162→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {
   163→        "strict": scores.strict,
   164→        "overall": scores.overall,
   165→        "objective": scores.objective,
   166→        "verified": scores.verified,
   167→    }
   168→    return True
   169→
   170→
   171→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(
   172→    state: state_mod.StateModel, plan: dict[str, object]
   173→) -> bool:
   174→    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
   175→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   176→        return False
   177→
   178→    try:
   179→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import plan_aware_queue_count
   180→
   181→        queue_empty = plan_aware_queue_count(state, plan) == 0
   182→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   183→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   184→        return False
   185→    if not queue_empty:
   186→        return False
   187→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   188→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   189→    return True
   190→
   191→
   192→def _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: "ScanRuntime") -> None:
   193→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   194→    try:
   195→        plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   196→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   197→        dirty = False
   198→
   199→        if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   200→            dirty = True
   201→
   202→        unscored_changed = _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_unscored_dimensions)
   203→        if unscored_changed:
   204→            dirty = True
   205→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_unscored", actor="system",
   206→                             detail={"changes": True})
   207→
   208→        stale_changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(plan, runtime.state, sync_stale_dimensions)
   209→        if stale_changed:
   210→            dirty = True
   211→            append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system",
   212→                             detail={"changes": True})
   213→
   214→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.score import target_strict_score_from_config
   215→        _target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   216→
   217→        auto_changed = _sync_auto_clusters(
   218→            plan, runtime.state, target_strict=_target_strict,
   219→        )
   220→        if auto_changed:
   221→            dirty = True
   222→            append_log_entry(plan, "auto_cluster", actor="system",
   223→                             detail={"changes": True})
   224→
   225→        triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   226→        if triage_sync.changes:
   227→            dirty = True
   228→            if triage_sync.injected:
   229→                print(
   230→                    colorize(
   231→                        "  Plan: planning mode needed — review findings changed since last triage.",
   232→                        "cyan",
   233→                    )
   234→                )
   235→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system",
   236→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   237→
   238→        create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, runtime.state)
   239→        if create_plan_sync.changes:
   240→            dirty = True
   241→            if create_plan_sync.injected:
   242→                print(
   243→                    colorize(
   244→                        "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   245→                        "cyan",
   246→                    )
   247→                )
   248→                append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system",
   249→                                 detail={"injected": True})
   250→
   251→        seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, runtime.state)
   252→        if seeded:
   253→            dirty = True
   254→            append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system",
   255→                             detail={})
   256→        # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   257→        # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   258→        if not seeded and _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(runtime.state, plan):
   259→            dirty = True
   260→            append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system",
   261→                             detail={})
   262→
   263→        if dirty:
   264→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   265→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   266→        logging.debug("Plan operation skipped: %s", exc)
   267→

   285→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities")
   286→    if capabilities is None:
   287→        normalized: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
   288→        state["lang_capabilities"] = normalized

   312→@dataclass
   313→class ScanRuntime:
   314→    """Resolved runtime context for a single scan invocation."""
   315→

   326→    reset_subjective_count: int = 0
   327→    expired_manual_override_count: int = 0

   354→def _configure_lang_runtime(
   355→    args: argparse.Namespace,
   356→    config: dict[str, object],
   357→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   358→    lang: LangRun | None,
   359→) -> LangRun | None:
   360→    """Populate runtime context and threshold overrides for a selected language."""
   361→    if not lang:
   362→        return None
   363→
   364→    lang_options = resolve_lang_runtime_options(args, lang)
   365→    lang_settings = resolve_lang_settings(config, lang)
   366→    runtime_lang = make_lang_run(
   367→        lang,
   368→        overrides=LangRunOverrides(
   369→            review_cache=state.get("review_cache", {}),
   370→            review_max_age_days=config.get("review_max_age_days", 30),
   371→            runtime_settings=lang_settings,
   372→            runtime_options=lang_options,
   373→            large_threshold_override=config.get("large_files_threshold", 0),
   374→            props_threshold_override=config.get("props_threshold", 0),
   375→        ),
   376→    )
   377→
   378→    lang_capabilities = _state_lang_capabilities(state)
   379→    lang_capabilities[runtime_lang.name] = {
   380→        "fixers": sorted(runtime_lang.fixers.keys()),
   381→        "typecheck_cmd": runtime_lang.typecheck_cmd,
   382→    }
   383→    return runtime_lang
   384→
   385→
   386→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   387→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   388→    *,
   389→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   390→) -> int:
   391→    """Reset known subjective dimensions to 0 so the next scan starts fresh."""
   392→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   393→
   394→    reset_keys = {
   395→        key.strip()
   396→        for key in assessments
   397→        if isinstance(key, str) and key.strip()
   398→    }
   399→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   400→
   401→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   402→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   403→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   404→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   405→            payload["score"] = 0.0
   406→            payload["source"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   407→            payload["assessed_at"] = now
   408→            payload["reset_by"] = "scan_reset_subjective"
   409→            payload["placeholder"] = True
   410→            payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   411→            payload.pop("components", None)
   412→            payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   413→            continue
   414→        assessments[key] = {
   415→            "score": 0.0,
   416→            "source": "scan_reset_subjective",
   417→            "assessed_at": now,
   418→            "reset_by": "scan_reset_subjective",
   419→            "placeholder": True,
   420→        }
   421→    return len(reset_keys)
   422→
   423→
   424→def _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   425→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   426→) -> int:
   427→    """Expire provisional manual-override assessments at scan start."""
   428→    assessments = _state_subjective_assessments(state)
   429→
   430→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   431→    expired = 0
   432→    for payload in assessments.values():
   433→        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   434→            continue
   435→        if payload.get("provisional_override") is not True:
   436→            continue
   437→        payload["score"] = 0.0
   438→        payload["source"] = "manual_override_expired"
   439→        payload["assessed_at"] = now
   440→        payload["reset_by"] = "manual_override_expired"
   441→        payload["placeholder"] = True
   442→        payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   443→        payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)
   444→        payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   445→        payload.pop("components", None)
   446→        payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   447→        expired += 1
   448→    return expired
   449→
   450→
   451→def prepare_scan_runtime(args) -> ScanRuntime:
   452→    """Resolve state/config/language and apply scan-time runtime settings."""
   453→    runtime = command_runtime(args)
   454→    state_file = runtime.state_path
   455→    state = runtime.state if isinstance(runtime.state, dict) else {}
   456→    state_mod.ensure_state_defaults(state)
   457→    path = Path(args.path)
   458→    config = runtime.config if isinstance(runtime.config, dict) else {}
   459→    lang_config = resolve_lang(args)
   460→    reset_subjective_count = 0
   461→    expired_manual_override_count = _expire_provisional_manual_override_assessments(
   462→        state
   463→    )
   464→    if getattr(args, "reset_subjective", False):
   465→        reset_subjective_count = _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   466→            state,
   467→            lang_name=getattr(lang_config, "name", None),
   468→        )
   469→
   470→    include_slow = not getattr(args, "skip_slow", False)
   471→    profile = _resolve_scan_profile(getattr(args, "profile", None), lang_config)
   472→    effective_include_slow = _effective_include_slow(include_slow, profile)
   473→
   474→    lang = _configure_lang_runtime(args, config, state, lang_config)
   475→    coverage_warnings = _seed_runtime_coverage_warnings(lang)
   476→    zone_overrides_raw = config.get("zone_overrides")
   477→    zone_overrides = zone_overrides_raw if isinstance(zone_overrides_raw, dict) else None
   478→
   479→    return ScanRuntime(
   480→        args=args,
   481→        state_path=state_file,
   482→        state=state,
   483→        path=path,
   484→        config=config,
   485→        lang=lang,
   486→        lang_label=f" ({lang.name})" if lang else "",
   487→        profile=profile,
   488→        effective_include_slow=effective_include_slow,
   489→        zone_overrides=zone_overrides,
   490→        reset_subjective_count=reset_subjective_count,
   491→        expired_manual_override_count=expired_manual_override_count,
   492→        coverage_warnings=coverage_warnings,
   493→    )
   494→

   496→def _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(
   497→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   498→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   499→) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   500→    """Append stale exclude findings when excluded dirs are unreferenced."""
   501→    extra_exclusions = get_exclusions()
   502→    if not (extra_exclusions and runtime.lang and runtime.lang.file_finder):
   503→        return findings
   504→
   505→    scanned_files = runtime.lang.file_finder(runtime.path)
   506→    stale = _audit_excluded_dirs(
   507→        extra_exclusions, scanned_files, PROJECT_ROOT
   508→    )
   509→    if not stale:
   510→        return findings
   511→
   512→    augmented = list(findings)
   513→    augmented.extend(stale)
   514→    for stale_finding in stale:
   515→        print(colorize(f"  ℹ {stale_finding['summary']}", "dim"))
   516→    return augmented
   517→
   518→
   519→def _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   520→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   521→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   522→    *,
   523→    decay_scans: int,
   524→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int]:
   525→    """Append re-triage findings for stale/worsening wontfix debt."""
   526→    return _augment_stale_wontfix_impl(
   527→        findings,
   528→        state=runtime.state,
   529→        scan_path=runtime.path,
   530→        project_root=PROJECT_ROOT,
   531→        decay_scans=decay_scans,
   532→    )

   534→
   535→def run_scan_generation(
   536→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   537→) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, object], dict[str, object] | None]:
   538→    """Run detector pipeline and return findings, potentials, and codebase metrics."""
   539→    enable_file_cache()
   540→    enable_parse_cache()
   541→    try:
   542→        findings, potentials = plan_mod.generate_findings(
   543→            runtime.path,
   544→            lang=runtime.lang,
   545→            options=PlanScanOptions(
   546→                include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   547→                zone_overrides=runtime.zone_overrides,
   548→                profile=runtime.profile,
   549→            ),
   550→        )
   551→    finally:
   552→        disable_parse_cache()
   553→        disable_file_cache()
   554→
   555→    codebase_metrics = _collect_codebase_metrics(runtime.lang, runtime.path)
   556→    _warn_explicit_lang_with_no_files(
   557→        runtime.args, runtime.lang, runtime.path, codebase_metrics
   558→    )
   559→    findings = _augment_with_stale_exclusion_findings(findings, runtime)
   560→    decay_scans = _coerce_int(
   561→        runtime.config.get("wontfix_decay_scans"),
   562→        default=_WONTFIX_DECAY_SCANS_DEFAULT,
   563→    )
   564→    findings, monitored_wontfix = _augment_with_stale_wontfix_findings(
   565→        findings,
   566→        runtime,
   567→        decay_scans=max(decay_scans, 0),
   568→    )
   569→    potentials["stale_wontfix"] = monitored_wontfix
   570→    return findings, potentials, codebase_metrics
   571→
   572→
   573→def merge_scan_results(
   574→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   575→    findings: list[dict[str, Any]],
   576→    potentials: dict[str, object],
   577→    codebase_metrics: dict[str, object] | None,
   578→) -> ScanMergeResult:
   579→    """Merge findings into persistent state and return diff + previous score snapshot."""
   580→    scan_path_rel = rel(str(runtime.path))
   581→    prev_scan_path = runtime.state.get("scan_path")
   582→    path_changed = prev_scan_path is not None and prev_scan_path != scan_path_rel
   583→
   584→    if not path_changed:
   585→        prev = state_mod.score_snapshot(runtime.state)
   586→    else:
   587→        prev = state_mod.ScoreSnapshot(None, None, None, None)
   588→    prev_dim_scores = (
   589→        runtime.state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if not path_changed else {}
   590→    )
   591→
   592→    if runtime.lang and runtime.lang.zone_map is not None:
   593→        runtime.state["zone_distribution"] = runtime.lang.zone_map.counts()
   594→    _persist_scan_coverage(runtime.state, runtime.lang)
   595→
   596→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   597→
   598→    diff = state_mod.merge_scan(
   599→        runtime.state,
   600→        findings,
   601→        options=state_mod.MergeScanOptions(
   602→            lang=runtime.lang.name if runtime.lang else None,
   603→            scan_path=scan_path_rel,
   604→            force_resolve=getattr(runtime.args, "force_resolve", False),
   605→            exclude=get_exclusions(),
   606→            potentials=potentials,
   607→            codebase_metrics=codebase_metrics,
   608→            include_slow=runtime.effective_include_slow,
   609→            ignore=runtime.config.get("ignore", []),
   610→            subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   611→        ),
   612→    )
   613→
   614→    issues_mod.expire_stale_holistic(
   615→        runtime.state, runtime.config.get("holistic_max_age_days", 30)
   616→    )
   617→    state_mod.save_state(
   618→        runtime.state,
   619→        runtime.state_path,
   620→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   621→    )
   622→
   623→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   624→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   625→
   626→    return ScanMergeResult(
   627→        diff=diff,
   628→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   629→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   630→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   631→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   632→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   633→    )
   634→
   635→
   636→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   637→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   638→    config: dict[str, object],
   639→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   640→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden finding counters."""
   641→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   642→        state_mod.resolve_finding_noise_settings(config)
   643→    )
   644→    findings_by_id = _state_findings(state)
   645→    open_findings = [
   646→        finding
   647→        for finding in state_mod.path_scoped_findings(
   648→            findings_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   649→        ).values()
   650→        if finding.get("status") == "open"
   651→    ]
   652→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_finding_noise_budget(
   653→        open_findings,
   654→        budget=noise_budget,
   655→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   656→    )
   657→
   658→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   659→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   660→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   661→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   662→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   663→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   664→    )
   665→
   666→
   667→def persist_reminder_history(
   668→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   669→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   670→) -> None:
   671→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   672→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   673→        return
   674→
   675→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   676→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config, fallback=95.0)
   677→    state_mod.save_state(
   678→        runtime.state,
   679→        runtime.state_path,
   680→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   681→    )

   684→__all__ = [

    10→
    11→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

    13→
    14→def resolve_project_name(project_root: Path) -> str:
    15→    """Resolve owner/repo display name from GitHub CLI, git remote, or folder."""
    16→    try:
    17→        name = subprocess.check_output(
    18→            ["gh", "repo", "view", "--json", "nameWithOwner", "-q", ".nameWithOwner"],
    19→            cwd=str(project_root),
    20→            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    21→            text=True,
    22→            timeout=5,
    23→        ).strip()
    24→        if "/" in name:
    25→            return name
    26→    except (
    27→        subprocess.CalledProcessError,
    28→        FileNotFoundError,
    29→        subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
    30→    ) as exc:
    31→        logger.debug("gh repo view failed, falling back to git remote: %s", exc)
    32→
    33→    try:
    34→        url = subprocess.check_output(
    35→            ["git", "config", "--get", "remote.origin.url"],
    36→            cwd=str(project_root),
    37→            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
    38→            text=True,
    39→            timeout=5,
    40→        ).strip()
    41→        if url.startswith("git@") and ":" in url:
    42→            path = url.split(":")[-1]
    43→        else:
    44→            path = "/".join(url.split("/")[-2:])
    45→        return path.removesuffix(".git")
    46→    except (
    47→        subprocess.CalledProcessError,
    48→        FileNotFoundError,
    49→        IndexError,
    50→        subprocess.TimeoutExpired,
    51→    ) as exc:
    52→        logger.debug("git remote lookup failed, falling back to folder name: %s", exc)
    53→        return project_root.name
    54→
    55→
    56→def resolve_package_version(
    57→    project_root: Path,
    58→    *,
    59→    version_getter: Callable[[str], str],
    60→    package_not_found_error: type[Exception],
    61→) -> str:
    62→    """Resolve package version from installed metadata or local pyproject."""
    63→    try:
    64→        return version_getter("desloppify")
    65→    except package_not_found_error as exc:
    66→        logger.debug("Package metadata lookup failed, trying pyproject.toml: %s", exc)
    67→
    68→    pyproject_path = project_root / "pyproject.toml"
    69→    try:
    70→        text = pyproject_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    71→        match = re.search(r'^\s*version\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"\s*$', text, re.MULTILINE)
    72→        if match:
    73→            return match.group(1)
    74→    except OSError as exc:
    75→        logger.debug("Failed to read pyproject.toml for version: %s", exc)
    76→
    77→    return "unknown"
    78→

1→"""Plan persistence — load/save with atomic writes."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→import json
     6→import logging
     7→import shutil
     8→import sys
     9→from pathlib import Path
    10→
    11→from desloppify.core.discovery_api import safe_write_text
    12→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import (
    13→    PLAN_VERSION,
    14→    PlanModel,
    15→    empty_plan,
    16→    ensure_plan_defaults,
    17→    validate_plan,
    18→)
    19→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import STATE_DIR, json_default
    20→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import utc_now
    21→
    22→logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
    23→
    24→PLAN_FILE = STATE_DIR / "plan.json"
    25→
    26→
    27→def load_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> PlanModel:
    28→    """Load plan from disk, or return empty plan on missing/corruption."""
    29→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    30→    if not plan_path.exists():
    31→        return empty_plan()
    32→
    33→    try:
    34→        data = json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
    35→    except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as ex:
    36→        # Try backup before giving up
    37→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    38→        if backup.exists():
    39→            try:
    40→                data = json.loads(backup.read_text())
    41→                logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s), loaded from backup.", ex)
    42→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}), loaded from backup.", file=sys.stderr)
    43→                # Fall through to validation below
    44→            except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as backup_ex:
    45→                logger.warning("Plan file and backup both corrupted: %s / %s", ex, backup_ex)
    46→                print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    47→                return empty_plan()
    48→        else:
    49→            logger.warning("Plan file corrupted (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    50→            print(f"  Warning: Plan file corrupted ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    51→            return empty_plan()
    52→
    53→    if not isinstance(data, dict):
    54→        logger.warning("Plan file root is not a JSON object. Starting fresh.")
    55→        print("  Warning: Plan file root must be a JSON object. Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    56→        return empty_plan()
    57→
    58→    version = data.get("version", 1)
    59→    if version > PLAN_VERSION:
    60→        logger.warning("Plan file version %d > supported %d.", version, PLAN_VERSION)
    61→        print(
    62→            f"  Warning: Plan file version {version} is newer than supported "
    63→            f"({PLAN_VERSION}). Some features may not work correctly.",
    64→            file=sys.stderr,
    65→        )
    66→
    67→    ensure_plan_defaults(data)
    68→    try:
    69→        validate_plan(data)
    70→    except ValueError as ex:
    71→        logger.warning("Plan invariants invalid (%s). Starting fresh.", ex)
    72→        print(f"  Warning: Plan invariants invalid ({ex}). Starting fresh.", file=sys.stderr)
    73→        return empty_plan()
    74→
    75→    return data  # type: ignore[return-value]
    76→
    77→
    78→def save_plan(plan: PlanModel | dict, path: Path | None = None) -> None:
    79→    """Validate and save plan to disk atomically."""
    80→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
    81→    plan["updated"] = utc_now()
    82→    validate_plan(plan)
    83→
    84→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
    85→    plan_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    86→
    87→    content = json.dumps(plan, indent=2, default=json_default) + "\n"
    88→
    89→    if plan_path.exists():
    90→        backup = plan_path.with_suffix(".json.bak")
    91→        try:
    92→            shutil.copy2(str(plan_path), str(backup))
    93→        except OSError as backup_ex:
    94→            logger.debug("Failed to create plan backup: %s", backup_ex)
    95→
    96→    try:
    97→        safe_write_text(plan_path, content)
    98→    except OSError as ex:
    99→        print(f"  Warning: Could not save plan: {ex}", file=sys.stderr)
   100→        raise
   101→
   102→
   103→def plan_path_for_state(state_path: Path) -> Path:
   104→    """Derive plan.json path from a state file path."""
   105→    return state_path.parent / "plan.json"
   106→
   107→
   108→def has_living_plan(path: Path | None = None) -> bool:
   109→    """Return True if a plan.json exists and has user intent."""
   110→    plan_path = path or PLAN_FILE
   111→    if not plan_path.exists():
   112→        return False
   113→    plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   114→    return bool(
   115→        plan.get("queue_order")
   116→        or plan.get("overrides")
   117→        or plan.get("clusters")
   118→    )
   119→
   120→
   121→__all__ = [
   122→    "PLAN_FILE",
   123→    "has_living_plan",
   124→    "load_plan",
   125→    "plan_path_for_state",
   126→    "save_plan",
   127→]
   128→

   109→    for filepath in files:

   195→        else:
   196→            scoped_files = []
   197→        batch["files_to_read"] = scoped_files
   198→
   199→        concern_signals = batch.get("concern_signals", [])
   200→        if isinstance(concern_signals, list):
   201→            batch["concern_signals"] = [
   202→                signal
   203→                for signal in concern_signals
   204→                if isinstance(signal, dict)
   205→                and _file_in_allowed_scope(signal.get("file", ""), allowed_files)
   206→            ]
   207→            if "concern_signal_count" in batch:
   208→                batch["concern_signal_count"] = len(batch["concern_signals"])
   209→
   210→        issue_focus = _filter_issue_focus_to_scope(
   211→            batch.get("historical_issue_focus"),
   212→            allowed_files,
   213→        )
   214→        if issue_focus is not None:
   215→            batch["historical_issue_focus"] = issue_focus
   216→
   217→        has_seed_files = bool(batch["files_to_read"])
   218→        has_signals = bool(batch.get("concern_signals"))
   219→        if has_seed_files or has_signals:
   220→            scoped_batches.append(batch)
   221→    return scoped_batches
   222→
   223→
   224→def prepare_review(
   225→    path: Path,
   226→    lang: object,
   227→    state: dict,
   228→    options: ReviewPrepareOptions | None = None,
   229→) -> dict[str, object]:
   230→    """Prepare review data for agent consumption. Returns structured dict.
   231→
   232→    If *files* is provided, skip file_finder (avoids redundant filesystem walks
   233→    when the caller already has the file list, e.g. from _setup_lang).
   234→    """
   235→    resolved_options = options or ReviewPrepareOptions()
   236→    resolved_options.max_files = _normalize_max_files(resolved_options.max_files)
   237→    all_files = (
   238→        resolved_options.files
   239→        if resolved_options.files is not None
   240→        else (lang.file_finder(path) if lang.file_finder else [])
   241→    )
   242→
   243→    # Enable file cache for entire prepare operation — context building,
   244→    # file selection, and content extraction all read the same files.
   245→    already_cached = is_file_cache_enabled()
   246→    if not already_cached:
   247→        enable_file_cache()
   248→    try:
   249→        context = build_review_context(path, lang, state, files=all_files)
   250→        selected = select_files_for_review(
   251→            lang,
   252→            path,
   253→            state,
   254→            options=ReviewSelectionOptions(
   255→                max_files=resolved_options.max_files,
   256→                max_age_days=resolved_options.max_age_days,
   257→                force_refresh=resolved_options.force_refresh,
   258→                files=all_files,
   259→            ),
   260→        )
   261→        file_requests = _build_file_requests(selected, lang, state)
   262→    finally:
   263→        if not already_cached:
   264→            disable_file_cache()
   265→
   266→    default_dims, dimension_prompts, system_prompt = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang.name)
   267→    dims = resolve_dimensions(
   268→        cli_dimensions=resolved_options.dimensions,
   269→        config_dimensions=resolved_options.config_dimensions,
   270→        default_dimensions=default_dims,
   271→    )
   272→    lang_guide = get_lang_guidance(lang.name)
   273→    valid_dims = set(dimension_prompts)
   274→    invalid_requested = [
   275→        dim for dim in (resolved_options.dimensions or []) if dim not in valid_dims
   276→    ]
   277→    invalid_config = [
   278→        dim
   279→        for dim in (resolved_options.config_dimensions or [])
   280→        if dim not in valid_dims
   281→    ]
   282→
   283→    return {
   284→        "command": "review",
   285→        "language": lang.name,
   286→        "dimensions": dims,
   287→        "dimension_prompts": {
   288→            d: dimension_prompts[d] for d in dims if d in dimension_prompts
   289→        },
   290→        "lang_guidance": lang_guide,
   291→        "context": serialize_context(context),
   292→        "system_prompt": system_prompt,
   293→        "files": file_requests,
   294→        "total_candidates": len(file_requests),
   295→        "cache_status": {
   296→            "fresh": count_fresh(state, resolved_options.max_age_days),
   297→            "stale": count_stale(state, resolved_options.max_age_days),
   298→            "new": len(file_requests),
   299→        },
   300→        "invalid_dimensions": {
   301→            "requested": invalid_requested,
   302→            "config": invalid_config,
   303→        },
   304→    }
   305→
   306→
   307→def _build_file_requests(files: list[str], lang, state: dict) -> list[dict]:
   308→    """Build per-file review request dicts."""
   309→    file_requests = []
   310→    for filepath in files:
   311→        content = read_file_text(abs_path(filepath))
   312→        if content is None:
   313→            continue
   314→
   315→        rpath = rel(filepath)
   316→        zone = "production"
   317→        if lang.zone_map is not None:
   318→            zone = lang.zone_map.get(filepath).value
   319→
   320→        neighbors: dict
   321→        if lang.dep_graph:
   322→            entry = dep_graph_lookup(lang.dep_graph, filepath)
   323→            imports_raw = entry.get("imports", set())
   324→            importers_raw = entry.get("importers", set())
   325→            importer_count_value = importer_count(entry)
   326→            neighbors = {
   327→                "imports": _rel_list(imports_raw),
   328→                "importers": _rel_list(importers_raw),
   329→                "importer_count": importer_count_value,
   330→            }
   331→        else:
   332→            neighbors = {}
   333→
   334→        file_requests.append(
   335→            {
   336→                "file": rpath,
   337→                "content": content,
   338→                "zone": zone,
   339→                "loc": len(content.splitlines()),
   340→                "neighbors": neighbors,
   341→                "existing_findings": get_file_findings(state, filepath),
   342→            }
   343→        )
   344→    return file_requests
   345→
   346→
   347→def prepare_holistic_review(
   348→    path: Path,
   349→    lang: object,
   350→    state: dict,
   351→    options: HolisticReviewPrepareOptions | None = None,
   352→) -> dict[str, object]:
   353→    """Prepare holistic review data for agent consumption. Returns structured dict."""
   354→    resolved_options = options or HolisticReviewPrepareOptions()
   355→    all_files = (
   356→        resolved_options.files
   357→        if resolved_options.files is not None
   358→        else (lang.file_finder(path) if lang.file_finder else [])
   359→    )
   360→    allowed_review_files = _collect_allowed_review_files(
   361→        all_files,
   362→        lang,
   363→        base_path=path,
   364→    )
   365→
   366→    already_cached = is_file_cache_enabled()
   367→    if not already_cached:
   368→        enable_file_cache()
   369→    try:
   370→        context = HolisticContext.from_raw(
   371→            build_holistic_context(path, lang, state, files=all_files)
   372→        )
   373→        # Also include per-file review context for reference
   374→        review_ctx = build_review_context(path, lang, state, files=all_files)
   375→    finally:
   376→        if not already_cached:
   377→            disable_file_cache()
   378→
   379→    default_dims, holistic_prompts, system_prompt = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang.name)
   380→    _, per_file_prompts, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(lang.name)
   381→    dims = resolve_dimensions(
   382→        cli_dimensions=resolved_options.dimensions,
   383→        default_dimensions=default_dims,
   384→    )
   385→    lang_guide = get_lang_guidance(lang.name)
   386→    valid_dims = set(holistic_prompts) | set(per_file_prompts)
   387→    invalid_requested = [
   388→        dim for dim in (resolved_options.dimensions or []) if dim not in valid_dims
   389→    ]
   390→    invalid_default = [dim for dim in default_dims if dim not in valid_dims]
   391→    batches = _build_investigation_batches(
   392→        context,
   393→        lang,
   394→        repo_root=path,
   395→        max_files_per_batch=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   396→    )
   397→
   398→    # Append design-coherence batch from mechanical concern signals.
   399→    try:
   400→        from desloppify.engine.concerns import generate_concerns
   401→
   402→        concerns = generate_concerns(state, lang_name=lang.name)
   403→        concerns = [
   404→            concern
   405→            for concern in concerns
   406→            if _file_in_allowed_scope(getattr(concern, "file", ""), allowed_review_files)
   407→        ]
   408→        concerns_batch = _batch_concerns(
   409→            concerns,
   410→            max_files=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   411→            active_dimensions=dims,
   412→        )
   413→        if concerns_batch:
   414→            batches.append(concerns_batch)
   415→    except (ImportError, AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
   416→        logger.debug("Concern generation failed (best-effort): %s", exc)
   417→
   418→    batches = _filter_batches_to_dimensions(
   419→        batches,
   420→        dims,
   421→        fallback_max_files=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   422→    )
   423→    include_full_sweep = bool(resolved_options.include_full_sweep)
   424→    # Explicitly scoped dimension runs should stay scoped by default.
   425→    if resolved_options.dimensions:
   426→        include_full_sweep = False
   427→    if include_full_sweep:
   428→        append_full_sweep_batch(
   429→            batches=batches,
   430→            dims=dims,
   431→            all_files=all_files,
   432→            lang=lang,
   433→            max_files=resolved_options.max_files_per_batch,
   434→        )
   435→    batches = _filter_batches_to_file_scope(
   436→        batches,
   437→        allowed_files=allowed_review_files,
   438→    )
   439→
   440→    # Holistic mode can receive per-file-oriented dimensions via CLI suggestions.
   441→    # Attach whichever prompt definition exists so reviewers always get guidance.
   442→    selected_prompts: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
   443→    for dim in dims:
   444→        prompt = holistic_prompts.get(dim)
   445→        if prompt is None:
   446→            prompt = per_file_prompts.get(dim)
   447→        if prompt is None:
   448→            continue
   449→        selected_prompts[dim] = prompt
   450→
   451→    payload = {
   452→        "command": "review",
   453→        "mode": "holistic",
   454→        "language": lang.name,
   455→        "dimensions": dims,
   456→        "dimension_prompts": selected_prompts,
   457→        "lang_guidance": lang_guide,
   458→        "holistic_context": context.to_dict(),
   459→        "review_context": serialize_context(review_ctx),
   460→        "system_prompt": system_prompt,
   461→        "total_files": context.codebase_stats.get("total_files", 0),
   462→        "workflow": HOLISTIC_WORKFLOW,
   463→        "invalid_dimensions": {
   464→            "requested": invalid_requested,
   465→            "default": invalid_default,
   466→        },
   467→    }
   468→    if resolved_options.include_issue_history:
   469→        history_payload = build_issue_history_context(
   470→            state,
   471→            options=ReviewHistoryOptions(
   472→                max_issues=resolved_options.issue_history_max_issues,
   473→            ),
   474→        )
   475→        payload["historical_review_issues"] = history_payload
   476→        for batch in batches:
   477→            if not isinstance(batch, dict):
   478→                continue
   479→            batch_dims = batch.get("dimensions", [])
   480→            batch["historical_issue_focus"] = build_batch_issue_focus(
   481→                history_payload,
   482→                dimensions=batch_dims,
   483→                max_items=resolved_options.issue_history_max_batch_items,
   484→            )
   485→        batches = _filter_batches_to_file_scope(
   486→            batches,
   487→            allowed_files=allowed_review_files,
   488→        )
   489→    payload["investigation_batches"] = batches
   490→    return payload

    36→    raise ImportError("; ".join(summaries))

    39→def _report_load_errors_for_load_all() -> None:
    40→    """Emit warning diagnostics for plugin failures without aborting discovery."""
    41→    try:
