   120→    for raw_dim, entry in prompts.items():
   121→        dim = _normalize_dimension_name(raw_dim)
   122→        if not dim:
   123→            continue
   124→
   125→        payload = target.setdefault(dim, {})
   126→        prompt_meta = _extract_prompt_meta(entry)
   127→
   128→        if "display_name" in prompt_meta and (
   129→            override_existing or "display_name" not in payload
   130→        ):
   131→            payload["display_name"] = prompt_meta["display_name"]
   132→        if "weight" in prompt_meta and (override_existing or "weight" not in payload):
   133→            payload["weight"] = prompt_meta["weight"]
   134→        if "reset_on_scan" in prompt_meta and (
   135→            override_existing or "reset_on_scan" not in payload
   136→        ):
   137→            payload["reset_on_scan"] = prompt_meta["reset_on_scan"]
   138→
   139→        if dim in defaults:
   140→            payload["enabled_by_default"] = True
   141→        if "enabled_by_default" in prompt_meta:
   142→            if override_existing:
   143→                payload["enabled_by_default"] = bool(prompt_meta["enabled_by_default"])
   144→            else:
   145→                payload["enabled_by_default"] = bool(
   146→                    payload.get("enabled_by_default", False)
   147→                    or prompt_meta["enabled_by_default"]
   148→                )
   149→
   150→
   151→def _available_languages() -> list[str]:
   152→    try:
   153→        return list(available_langs())
   154→    except (ImportError, ValueError, TypeError, RuntimeError):
   155→        return []
   156→
   157→
   158→def _build_subjective_dimension_metadata(
   159→    *,
   160→    lang_name: str | None,
   161→) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
   162→    """Build merged metadata for subjective dimensions."""
   163→    out: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
   164→
   165→    shared_defaults, shared_prompts, _ = load_dimensions()
   166→    _merge_dimension_meta(out, dimensions=shared_defaults, prompts=shared_prompts)
   167→
   168→    langs = [lang_name] if isinstance(lang_name, str) and lang_name.strip() else _available_languages()
   169→    for name in langs:
   170→        try:
   171→            lang_defaults, lang_prompts, _ = load_dimensions_for_lang(name)
   172→            _merge_dimension_meta(
   173→                out,
   174→                dimensions=lang_defaults,
   175→                prompts=lang_prompts,
   176→                override_existing=bool(lang_name),
   177→            )
   178→        except (ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
   179→            logger.debug("Failed to load dimensions for lang %s: %s", name, exc)
   180→            continue
   181→
   182→    for dim, payload in out.items():
   183→        payload.setdefault(
   184→            "display_name",
   185→            _LEGACY_DISPLAY_NAMES.get(dim, _title_display_name(dim)),
   186→        )
   187→        payload.setdefault("weight", _LEGACY_WEIGHT_BY_DIMENSION.get(dim, 1.0))
   188→        payload.setdefault("enabled_by_default", False)
   189→        if dim in _LEGACY_DISPLAY_NAMES:
   190→            payload.setdefault(
   191→                "reset_on_scan", dim in _LEGACY_RESET_ON_SCAN_DIMENSIONS
   192→            )
   193→        else:
   194→            payload.setdefault("reset_on_scan", True)
   195→
   196→    # Preserve legacy dimensions even if a payload temporarily drops one.
   197→    for dim, display in _LEGACY_DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   198→        payload = out.setdefault(dim, {})
   199→        payload.setdefault("display_name", display)
   200→        payload.setdefault("weight", _LEGACY_WEIGHT_BY_DIMENSION.get(dim, 1.0))
   201→        payload.setdefault("enabled_by_default", True)
   202→        payload.setdefault("reset_on_scan", dim in _LEGACY_RESET_ON_SCAN_DIMENSIONS)
   203→
   204→    return out
   205→
   206→
   207→@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
   208→def load_subjective_dimension_metadata() -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
   209→    """Return merged metadata across all known dimensions/languages."""
   210→    return _build_subjective_dimension_metadata(lang_name=None)
   211→
   212→
   213→@lru_cache(maxsize=16)
   214→def load_subjective_dimension_metadata_for_lang(
   215→    lang_name: str | None,
   216→) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
   217→    """Return merged metadata for one language (with language overrides)."""
   218→    normalized = _normalize_lang_name(lang_name)
   219→    return _build_subjective_dimension_metadata(lang_name=normalized)
   220→
   221→
   222→def _metadata_registry(lang_name: str | None) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]]:
   223→    normalized = _normalize_lang_name(lang_name)
   224→    if normalized is None:
   225→        return load_subjective_dimension_metadata()
   226→    return load_subjective_dimension_metadata_for_lang(normalized)
   227→
   228→
   229→def _dimension_metadata_payload(
   230→    dimension_name: str,
   231→    *,
   232→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   233→) -> dict[str, object]:
   234→    dim = _normalize_dimension_name(dimension_name)
   235→    all_meta = _metadata_registry(lang_name)
   236→    payload = dict(all_meta.get(dim, {}))
   237→
   238→    payload.setdefault("display_name", _title_display_name(dim))
   239→    payload.setdefault("weight", 1.0)
   240→    payload.setdefault("enabled_by_default", False)
   241→    payload.setdefault("reset_on_scan", True)
   242→    return payload
   243→
   244→
   245→def get_dimension_metadata(
   246→    dimension_name: str,
   247→    *,
   248→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   249→) -> dict[str, object]:
   250→    """Return metadata for one dimension key (with sane defaults)."""
   251→    return _dimension_metadata_payload(dimension_name, lang_name=lang_name)
   252→
   253→
   254→def dimension_display_name(dimension_name: str, *, lang_name: str | None = None) -> str:
   255→    meta = get_dimension_metadata(dimension_name, lang_name=lang_name)
   256→    return str(meta.get("display_name", _title_display_name(dimension_name)))
   257→
   258→
   259→def dimension_weight(dimension_name: str, *, lang_name: str | None = None) -> float:
   260→    meta = get_dimension_metadata(dimension_name, lang_name=lang_name)
   261→    raw = meta.get("weight", 1.0)
   262→    if is_numeric(raw):
   263→        return max(0.0, float(raw))
   264→    return 1.0
   265→
   266→
   267→def default_display_names_map(*, lang_name: str | None = None) -> dict[str, str]:
   268→    """Display-name map for default subjective dimensions."""
   269→    out: dict[str, str] = {}
   270→    for dim, payload in _metadata_registry(lang_name).items():
   271→        if not bool(payload.get("enabled_by_default", False)):
   272→            continue
   273→        out[dim] = str(payload.get("display_name", _title_display_name(dim)))
   274→    return out
   275→
   276→
   277→def _resettable_default_dimensions_payload(
   278→    *,
   279→    lang_name: str | None = None,
   280→) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   281→    out = []
   282→    for dim, payload in _metadata_registry(lang_name).items():
   283→        if not bool(payload.get("enabled_by_default", False)):
   284→            continue
   285→        if not bool(payload.get("reset_on_scan", True)):
   286→            continue
   287→        out.append(dim)
   288→    return tuple(sorted(set(out)))
   289→
   290→
   291→def resettable_default_dimensions(*, lang_name: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, ...]:
   292→    """Default subjective dimensions that should be reset by scan reset."""
   293→    return _resettable_default_dimensions_payload(lang_name=lang_name)
   294→
   295→
   296→__all__ = [
   297→    "default_display_names_map",
   298→    "dimension_display_name",
   299→    "dimension_weight",
   300→    "get_dimension_metadata",
   301→    "load_subjective_dimension_metadata",
   302→    "load_subjective_dimension_metadata_for_lang",
   303→    "resettable_default_dimensions",
   304→]
   305→

    71→def _current_stale_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    72→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently stale."""
    73→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
    74→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
    75→        scorecard_subjective_entries,
    76→    )
    77→
    78→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
    79→    if not dim_scores:
    80→        return set()
    81→
    82→    stale: set[str] = set()
    83→    for entry in scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
    84→        if not entry.get("stale"):
    85→            continue
    86→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
    87→        if dim_key:
    88→            stale.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
    89→    return stale

    92→def current_unscored_ids(state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
    93→    """Return the set of ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are currently unscored (placeholder).
    94→
    95→    Checks ``subjective_assessments`` first; when that dict is empty
    96→    (common before any reviews have been run), falls through to
    97→    ``dimension_scores`` which carries placeholder metadata from scan.
    98→    """
    99→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
   100→
   101→    # Primary source: subjective_assessments with placeholder=True
   102→    assessments = state.get("subjective_assessments")
   103→    if isinstance(assessments, dict) and assessments:
   104→        unscored: set[str] = set()
   105→        for dim_key, payload in assessments.items():
   106→            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
   107→                continue
   108→            if not payload.get("placeholder"):
   109→                continue
   110→            if dim_key:
   111→                unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
   112→        return unscored
   113→
   114→    # Fallback: check dimension_scores directly for placeholder subjective
   115→    # dimensions.  This handles the common case where subjective_assessments
   116→    # hasn't been populated yet but dimension_scores already has placeholder
   117→    # entries from scan.  We can't use scorecard_subjective_entries() here
   118→    # because the scorecard pipeline intentionally hides placeholders.
   119→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   120→    if not dim_scores:
   121→        return set()
   122→
   123→    unscored = set()
   124→    for _name, data in dim_scores.items():
   125→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   126→            continue
   127→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
   128→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment")
   129→        if not isinstance(meta, dict):
   130→            continue
   131→        if not meta.get("placeholder"):
   132→            continue
   133→        dim_key = meta.get("dimension_key", "")
   134→        if dim_key:
   135→            unscored.add(f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}")
   136→    return unscored

   139→def current_under_target_ids(
   140→    state: StateModel,
   141→    *,
   142→    target_strict: float = 95.0,
   143→) -> set[str]:
   144→    """Return ``subjective::<slug>`` IDs that are under target but not stale or unscored.
   145→
   146→    These are dimensions whose assessment is still current (not needing refresh)
   147→    but whose score hasn't reached the target yet.
   148→    """
   149→    from desloppify.engine._work_queue.helpers import slugify
   150→    from desloppify.engine.planning.scorecard_projection import (
   151→        scorecard_subjective_entries,
   152→    )
   153→
   154→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {}) or {}
   155→    if not dim_scores:
   156→        return set()
   157→
   158→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   159→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   160→
   161→    under_target: set[str] = set()
   162→    for entry in scorecard_subjective_entries(state, dim_scores=dim_scores):
   163→        if entry.get("placeholder") or entry.get("stale"):
   164→            continue
   165→        strict_val = float(entry.get("strict", entry.get("score", 100.0)))
   166→        if strict_val >= target_strict:
   167→            continue
   168→        dim_key = entry.get("dimension_key", "")
   169→        if not dim_key:
   170→            continue
   171→        fid = f"{SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX}{slugify(dim_key)}"
   172→        if fid not in stale_ids and fid not in unscored_ids:
   173→            under_target.add(fid)
   174→    return under_target
   175→
   176→
   177→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   178→# Promoted-aware insertion helper
   179→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   180→
   181→def _after_promoted(order: list[str], plan: PlanModel) -> int:
   182→    """Return the insertion index just after the last promoted item in *order*.
   183→
   184→    When no promoted items are present (or none are in *order*), returns 0
   185→    so callers fall back to existing front-of-queue behavior.
   186→    """
   187→    promoted = set(plan.get("promoted_ids", []))
   188→    if not promoted:
   189→        return 0
   190→    last_idx = -1
   191→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   192→        if fid in promoted:
   193→            last_idx = i
   194→    return last_idx + 1 if last_idx >= 0 else 0
   195→
   196→
   197→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   198→# Unscored dimension sync (front of queue, unconditional)
   199→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   200→
   201→def sync_unscored_dimensions(
   202→    plan: PlanModel,
   203→    state: StateModel,
   204→) -> UnscoredDimensionSyncResult:
   205→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.
   206→
   207→    1. **Prune** — remove ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are
   208→       no longer unscored AND not stale (avoids pruning stale IDs — that is
   209→       ``sync_stale_dimensions``' responsibility).
   210→    2. **Inject** — unconditionally prepend currently-unscored IDs to the
   211→       *front* of ``queue_order`` so initial reviews are the first priority.
   212→    """
   213→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   214→    result = UnscoredDimensionSyncResult()
   215→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   216→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   217→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   218→
   219→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   220→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   221→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   222→        fid for fid in order
   223→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   224→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   225→        and fid not in stale_ids
   226→    ]
   227→    for fid in to_remove:
   228→        order.remove(fid)
   229→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   230→
   231→    # --- Inject: prepend unscored IDs after any promoted items -------------
   232→    existing = set(order)
   233→    insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   234→    for uid in reversed(sorted(unscored_ids)):
   235→        if uid not in existing:
   236→            order.insert(insert_at, uid)
   237→            result.injected.append(uid)
   238→
   239→    return result
   240→
   241→
   242→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   243→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   244→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   245→
   246→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   247→    plan: PlanModel,
   248→    state: StateModel,
   249→    *,
   250→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   251→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   252→) -> StaleDimensionSyncResult:
   253→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   254→
   255→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   256→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   257→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   258→    2. Inject stale and under-target dimension IDs when either:
   259→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle: append to back), OR
   260→       b. A cycle just completed (post-cycle: insert at front so subjective
   261→          review takes priority over new objective findings).
   262→    """
   263→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   264→    result = StaleDimensionSyncResult()
   265→    stale_ids = _current_stale_ids(state)
   266→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   267→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   268→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   269→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   270→
   271→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   272→    # Only prune IDs that are no longer injectable and not unscored.
   273→    to_remove: list[str] = [
   274→        fid for fid in order
   275→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX)
   276→        and fid not in injectable_ids
   277→        and fid not in unscored_ids
   278→    ]
   279→    for fid in to_remove:
   280→        order.remove(fid)
   281→        result.pruned.append(fid)
   282→
   283→    # --- Inject: populate stale + under-target dimensions -----------------
   284→    if policy is not None:
   285→        has_real_items = policy.has_objective_backlog
   286→    else:
   287→        has_real_items = any(
   288→            f.get("status") == "open"
   289→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   290→            and not f.get("suppressed")
   291→            for f in state.get("findings", {}).values()
   292→        )
   293→
   294→    should_inject = not has_real_items or cycle_just_completed
   295→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   296→        existing = set(order)
   297→        if cycle_just_completed and has_real_items:
   298→            # Post-cycle: front-of-queue after promoted items so subjective
   299→            # review happens before the new objective cycle begins.
   300→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   301→            for sid in reversed(sorted(injectable_ids)):
   302→                if sid not in existing:
   303→                    order.insert(insert_at, sid)
   304→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   305→        else:
   306→            # Mid-cycle or no objective backlog: append to back.
   307→            for sid in sorted(injectable_ids):
   308→                if sid not in existing:
   309→                    order.append(sid)
   310→                    result.injected.append(sid)
   311→
   312→    return result
   313→
   314→
   315→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   316→# Triage snapshot hash + sync
   317→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   318→
   319→def review_finding_snapshot_hash(state: StateModel) -> str:
   320→    """Hash open review finding IDs to detect changes.
   321→
   322→    Returns empty string when there are no open review findings.
   323→    """
   324→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   325→    review_ids = sorted(
   326→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   327→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   328→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   329→    )
   330→    if not review_ids:
   331→        return ""
   332→    return hashlib.sha256("|".join(review_ids).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
   333→
   334→
   335→@dataclass
   336→class TriageSyncResult:
   337→    """What changed during a triage sync."""
   338→
   339→    injected: bool = False
   340→    pruned: bool = False
   341→
   342→    @property
   343→    def changes(self) -> int:
   344→        return int(self.injected) + int(self.pruned)
   345→
   346→
   347→def sync_triage_needed(
   348→    plan: PlanModel,
   349→    state: StateModel,
   350→) -> TriageSyncResult:
   351→    """Inject 4 triage stage IDs at front of queue when review findings change.
   352→
   353→    Only injects stages not already confirmed in ``epic_triage_meta``.
   354→    Never auto-prunes — only explicit completion removes them.
   355→
   356→    When findings are *resolved* (current IDs are a subset of previously
   357→    triaged IDs), the snapshot hash is updated silently — no re-triage
   358→    is needed since the user is working through the plan.
   359→    """
   360→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   361→    result = TriageSyncResult()
   362→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   363→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   364→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   365→
   366→    # Check if any triage stage is already in queue
   367→    already_present = any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS)
   368→
   369→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   370→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   371→
   372→    if current_hash and current_hash != last_hash and not already_present:
   373→        # Distinguish "new findings appeared" from "findings were resolved".
   374→        # Only re-triage when genuinely new findings exist.
   375→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   376→        current_review_ids = {
   377→            fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   378→            if f.get("status") == "open"
   379→            and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   380→        }
   381→        triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   382→        new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   383→
   384→        if new_since_triage:
   385→            # New review findings appeared — re-triage needed
   386→            insert_at = _after_promoted(order, plan)
   387→            stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   388→            existing = set(order)
   389→            injected_count = 0
   390→            for sid, name in zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names):
   391→                if name not in confirmed and sid not in existing:
   392→                    order.insert(insert_at + injected_count, sid)
   393→                    injected_count += 1
   394→            if injected_count:
   395→                result.injected = True
   396→        else:
   397→            # Only resolved findings changed the hash — update silently
   398→            meta["finding_snapshot_hash"] = current_hash
   399→            plan["epic_triage_meta"] = meta
   400→
   401→    return result
   402→
   403→
   404→@dataclass
   405→class CreatePlanSyncResult:
   406→    """What changed during a create-plan sync."""
   407→
   408→    injected: bool = False
   409→
   410→    @property
   411→    def changes(self) -> int:
   412→        return int(self.injected)
   413→
   414→
   415→def sync_create_plan_needed(
   416→    plan: PlanModel,
   417→    state: StateModel,
   418→    *,
   419→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   420→) -> CreatePlanSyncResult:
   421→    """Inject ``workflow::create-plan`` when reviews complete + objective backlog exists.
   422→
   423→    Only injects when:
   424→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
   425→    - At least one objective finding exists
   426→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
   427→    - No triage stages are pending
   428→    """
   429→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   430→    result = CreatePlanSyncResult()
   431→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   432→
   433→    if WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID in order:
   434→        return result
   435→
   436→    # Don't inject if triage stages are pending
   437→    if any(sid in order for sid in TRIAGE_IDS):
   438→        return result
   439→
   440→    # Check that no unscored dimensions remain
   441→    if policy is not None:
   442→        if policy.unscored_ids:
   443→            return result
   444→        has_objective = policy.has_objective_backlog
   445→    else:
   446→        unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   447→        if unscored:
   448→            return result
   449→        findings = state.get("findings", {})
   450→        has_objective = any(
   451→            f.get("status") == "open"
   452→            and f.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   453→            for f in findings.values()
   454→        )
   455→    if not has_objective:
   456→        return result
   457→
   458→    # Insert after any subjective items, before findings
   459→    insert_at = 0
   460→    for i, fid in enumerate(order):
   461→        if fid.startswith(SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX) or fid.startswith(TRIAGE_PREFIX):
   462→            insert_at = i + 1
   463→    order.insert(insert_at, WORKFLOW_CREATE_PLAN_ID)
   464→    result.injected = True
   465→    return result
   466→
   467→
   468→def compute_new_finding_ids(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> set[str]:
   469→    """Return the set of open review/concerns finding IDs added since last triage.
   470→
   471→    Returns an empty set when no prior triage has recorded ``triaged_ids``.
   472→    """
   473→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   474→    triaged = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", meta.get("synthesized_ids", [])))
   475→    current = {
   476→        fid for fid, f in state.get("findings", {}).items()
   477→        if f.get("status") == "open" and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   478→    }
   479→    return current - triaged if triaged else set()
   480→
   481→
   482→def is_triage_stale(plan: PlanModel, state: StateModel) -> bool:
   483→    """Side-effect-free check: is triage needed?
   484→
   485→    Returns True when any ``triage::*`` stage ID is in the queue OR
   486→    genuinely *new* review findings appeared since the last triage.
   487→
   488→    When findings are merely resolved (current IDs are a subset of
   489→    previously triaged IDs), triage is NOT stale — the user is working
   490→    through the plan.
   491→    """
   492→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   493→    order = set(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   494→    if order & TRIAGE_IDS:
   495→        return True
   496→    meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   497→    last_hash = meta.get("finding_snapshot_hash", "")
   498→    if not last_hash:
   499→        return False
   500→    current_hash = review_finding_snapshot_hash(state)
   501→    if not current_hash or current_hash == last_hash:
   502→        return False
   503→    # Hash changed — check if new findings appeared or only resolutions
   504→    findings = state.get("findings", {})
   505→    current_review_ids = {
   506→        fid for fid, f in findings.items()
   507→        if f.get("status") == "open"
   508→        and f.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   509→    }
   510→    triaged_ids = set(meta.get("triaged_ids", []))
   511→    new_since_triage = current_review_ids - triaged_ids
   512→    return bool(new_since_triage)
   513→
   514→
   515→
   516→__all__ = [

1→"""Scorecard dimension row helpers for the engine/planning layer.
     2→
     3→Provides ``scorecard_dimension_rows`` without importing app-layer modules.
     4→The app scorecard surface re-exports this so external call-sites are unaffected.
     5→"""
     6→
     7→from __future__ import annotations
     8→
     9→from desloppify.scoring import DIMENSIONS
    10→
    11→
    12→def scorecard_dimension_rows(
    13→    state: dict,
    14→    *,
    15→    dim_scores: dict | None = None,
    16→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    17→    """Return scorecard rows using canonical dimension ordering.
    18→
    19→    Tries ``prepare_scorecard_dimensions`` from the app layer when available
    20→    (deferred import to avoid hard engine -> app dependency), then falls back
    21→    to a simple mechanical-dimension listing.
    22→    """
    23→    if dim_scores is None:
    24→        dim_scores = (
    25→            state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if isinstance(state, dict) else {}
    26→        )
    27→        projected_state = state
    28→    else:
    29→        projected_state = dict(state)
    30→        projected_state["dimension_scores"] = dim_scores
    31→
    32→    # Try the full app-layer scorecard projection when it can be imported.
    33→    try:
    34→        from desloppify.app.output.scorecard_parts.dimensions import (
    35→            prepare_scorecard_dimensions,
    36→        )
    37→
    38→        rows = prepare_scorecard_dimensions(projected_state)
    39→        if rows:
    40→            return rows
    41→    except ImportError as exc:
    42→        _ = exc
    43→
    44→    # Fallback for synthetic/unit-test states without full scorecard context.
    45→    fallback_dim_scores = dim_scores or {}
    46→    if not isinstance(fallback_dim_scores, dict):
    47→        return []
    48→
    49→    mechanical_names = [dimension.name for dimension in DIMENSIONS]
    50→    fallback_rows: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    51→    for name in mechanical_names:
    52→        data = fallback_dim_scores.get(name)
    53→        if isinstance(data, dict):
    54→            fallback_rows.append((name, data))
    55→    fallback_rows.extend(
    56→        sorted(
    57→            [
    58→                (name, data)
    59→                for name, data in fallback_dim_scores.items()
    60→                if name not in mechanical_names and isinstance(data, dict)
    61→            ],
    62→            key=lambda item: item[0].lower(),
    63→        )
    64→    )
    65→    return fallback_rows
    66→

    27→def detail_dict(item: dict) -> dict:
    28→    """Return finding detail as a dict; tolerate legacy/non-dict payloads."""
    29→    detail = item.get("detail")
    30→    return detail if isinstance(detail, dict) else {}
    31→
    32→
    33→def status_matches(item_status: str, status_filter: str) -> bool:
    34→    return status_filter == "all" or item_status == status_filter
    35→
    36→
    37→def is_subjective_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    38→    detector = item.get("detector")
    39→    if detector in {"subjective_assessment"}:
    40→        return True
    41→    if detector == "holistic_review":
    42→        return True
    43→    return False
    44→
    45→
    46→def is_review_finding(item: dict) -> bool:
    47→    return item.get("detector") == "review"
    48→
    49→
    50→def is_subjective_queue_item(item: dict) -> bool:
    51→    """True for subjective work items, including collapsed subjective clusters."""
    52→    if item.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension":
    53→        return True
    54→    if item.get("kind") == "cluster":
    55→        members = item.get("members", [])
    56→        return bool(members) and all(
    57→            m.get("kind") == "subjective_dimension" for m in members
    58→        )
    59→    return False
    60→
    61→
    62→def review_finding_weight(item: dict) -> float:
    63→    """Return review issue weight aligned with issues list ordering."""
    64→    confidence = str(item.get("confidence", "low")).lower()
    65→    weight_by_confidence = {
    66→        "high": 1.0,
    67→        "medium": 0.7,
    68→        "low": 0.3,
    69→    }
    70→    weight = weight_by_confidence.get(confidence, 0.3)
    71→    if detail_dict(item).get("holistic"):
    72→        weight *= 10.0
    73→    return float(weight)
    74→
    75→
    76→def scope_matches(item: dict, scope: str | None) -> bool:
    77→    """Apply show-style pattern matching against a queue item."""
    78→    if not scope:
    79→        return True
    80→
    81→    item_id = item.get("id", "")
    82→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
    83→    filepath = item.get("file", "")
    84→    summary = item.get("summary", "")
    85→    dimension = detail_dict(item).get("dimension_name", "")
    86→    kind = item.get("kind", "")
    87→
    88→    if "*" in scope:
    89→        return any(
    90→            fnmatch(candidate, scope)
    91→            for candidate in (item_id, filepath, detector, dimension, summary)
    92→        )
    93→
    94→    if "::" in scope:
    95→        return item_id.startswith(scope)
    96→
    97→    lowered = scope.lower()
    98→    if kind == "subjective_dimension":
    99→        return (
   100→            lowered in item_id.lower()
   101→            or lowered in dimension.lower()
   102→            or lowered in summary.lower()
   103→        )
   104→
   105→    # Hash suffix: 8+ hex chars matches the tail segment of a finding ID.
   106→    if len(lowered) >= 8 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]+", lowered):
   107→        return item_id.lower().endswith("::" + lowered)
   108→
   109→    return (
   110→        detector == scope
   111→        or filepath == scope
   112→        or filepath.startswith(scope.rstrip("/") + "/")
   113→    )

   116→def slugify(text: str) -> str:
   117→    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9_]+", "_", text.lower()).strip("_")

   120→def _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(display_name: str) -> str:
   121→    """Map a display label (e.g. 'Mid elegance') to its canonical dimension key."""
   122→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   123→    target = cleaned.lower()
   124→
   125→    for dim_key, label in DISPLAY_NAMES.items():
   126→        if str(label).lower() == target:
   127→            return str(dim_key)
   128→    return slugify(cleaned)

   132→    """Return normalized aliases used to match display labels with finding dimension keys."""
   133→    cleaned = display_name.replace(" (subjective)", "").strip()
   134→    canonical = _canonical_subjective_dimension_key(cleaned)
   135→    return {
   136→        cleaned.lower(),
   137→        cleaned.replace(" ", "_").lower(),
   138→        slugify(cleaned),
   139→        canonical.lower(),
   140→        slugify(canonical),
   141→    }

   144→def supported_fixers_for_item(state: dict, item: dict) -> set[str] | None:
   145→    """Return supported fixers for an item's language when known."""
   146→    lang = str(item.get("lang", "") or "").strip()
   147→    if not lang:
   148→        return None
   149→
   150→    caps = state.get("lang_capabilities", {})
   151→    if not isinstance(caps, dict):
   152→        return None
   153→
   154→    lang_caps = caps.get(lang, {})
   155→    if not isinstance(lang_caps, dict):
   156→        return None
   157→
   158→    fixers = lang_caps.get("fixers")
   159→    if not isinstance(fixers, list):
   160→        return None
   161→    return {fixer for fixer in fixers if isinstance(fixer, str)}

   164→def primary_command_for_finding(
   165→    item: dict, *, supported_fixers: set[str] | None = None
   166→) -> str:
   167→    detector = item.get("detector", "")
   168→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
   169→    if meta and meta.action_type == "auto_fix" and meta.fixers:
   170→        available_fixers = [
   171→            fixer
   172→            for fixer in meta.fixers
   173→            if supported_fixers is not None and fixer in supported_fixers
   174→        ]
   175→        if available_fixers:
   176→            return f"desloppify fix {available_fixers[0]} --dry-run"
   177→    if detector == "subjective_review":
   178→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(item):

   180→        return "desloppify show subjective"

   196→    )

   199→    order_set = set(order)
   200→    present = order_set & TRIAGE_IDS
   201→    if not present:

   203→

   205→    confirmed = set(meta.get("triage_stages", {}).keys())
   206→

   208→    open_review_count = sum(

   210→        if f.get("status") == "open"

   212→    )

   214→    label_map = dict(TRIAGE_STAGE_LABELS)
   215→    stage_names = ("observe", "reflect", "organize", "commit")
   216→

   218→    for idx, (sid, name) in enumerate(zip(TRIAGE_STAGE_IDS, stage_names)):
   219→        if sid not in present:
   220→            continue
   221→        if name in confirmed:
   222→            continue
   223→
   224→        # Compute blocked_by: dependency stages that are still in the queue

   226→        blocked_by = sorted(

   229→        )
   230→

   232→        if name == "commit":

   234→
   235→        items.append({

   249→            },

   309→def _unassessed_entries_from_dim_scores(dim_scores: dict) -> list[dict]:

   334→                "tier": int(data.get("tier", 4) or 4),

   408→        [REDACTED](name)

   427→        else:

1→"""Scorecard dimension row helpers for the engine/planning layer.
     2→
     3→Provides ``scorecard_dimension_rows`` without importing app-layer modules.
     4→The app scorecard surface re-exports this so external call-sites are unaffected.
     5→"""
     6→
     7→from __future__ import annotations
     8→
     9→from desloppify.scoring import DIMENSIONS
    10→
    11→
    12→def scorecard_dimension_rows(
    13→    state: dict,
    14→    *,
    15→    dim_scores: dict | None = None,
    16→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    17→    """Return scorecard rows using canonical dimension ordering.
    18→
    19→    Tries ``prepare_scorecard_dimensions`` from the app layer when available
    20→    (deferred import to avoid hard engine -> app dependency), then falls back
    21→    to a simple mechanical-dimension listing.
    22→    """
    23→    if dim_scores is None:
    24→        dim_scores = (
    25→            state.get("dimension_scores", {}) if isinstance(state, dict) else {}
    26→        )
    27→        projected_state = state
    28→    else:
    29→        projected_state = dict(state)
    30→        projected_state["dimension_scores"] = dim_scores
    31→
    32→    # Try the full app-layer scorecard projection when it can be imported.
    33→    try:
    34→        from desloppify.app.output.scorecard_parts.dimensions import (
    35→            prepare_scorecard_dimensions,
    36→        )
    37→
    38→        rows = prepare_scorecard_dimensions(projected_state)
    39→        if rows:
    40→            return rows
    41→    except ImportError as exc:
    42→        _ = exc
    43→
    44→    # Fallback for synthetic/unit-test states without full scorecard context.
    45→    fallback_dim_scores = dim_scores or {}
    46→    if not isinstance(fallback_dim_scores, dict):
    47→        return []
    48→
    49→    mechanical_names = [dimension.name for dimension in DIMENSIONS]
    50→    fallback_rows: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    51→    for name in mechanical_names:
    52→        data = fallback_dim_scores.get(name)
    53→        if isinstance(data, dict):
    54→            fallback_rows.append((name, data))
    55→    fallback_rows.extend(
    56→        sorted(
    57→            [
    58→                (name, data)
    59→                for name, data in fallback_dim_scores.items()
    60→                if name not in mechanical_names and isinstance(data, dict)
    61→            ],
    62→            key=lambda item: item[0].lower(),
    63→        )
    64→    )
    65→    return fallback_rows
    66→

    16→def _lang_from_scan_history(state: dict) -> str | None:
    17→    history = state.get("scan_history")
    18→    if not isinstance(history, list):
    19→        return None
    20→    for entry in reversed(history):
    21→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
    22→            continue
    23→        lang = entry.get("lang")
    24→        if isinstance(lang, str) and lang.strip():
    25→            return lang.strip().lower()
    26→    return None
    27→
    28→
    29→def _lang_from_capabilities(state: dict) -> str | None:
    30→    capabilities = state.get("lang_capabilities")
    31→    if not isinstance(capabilities, dict) or len(capabilities) != 1:
    32→        return None
    33→    only_lang = next(iter(capabilities.keys()))
    34→    if isinstance(only_lang, str) and only_lang.strip():
    35→        return only_lang.strip().lower()
    36→    return None
    37→
    38→
    39→def _lang_from_findings(state: dict) -> str | None:
    40→    findings = state.get("findings")
    41→    if not isinstance(findings, dict):
    42→        return None
    43→    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    44→    for finding in findings.values():
    45→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
    46→            continue
    47→        lang = finding.get("lang")
    48→        if not isinstance(lang, str) or not lang.strip():
    49→            continue
    50→        key = lang.strip().lower()
    51→        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    52→    if counts:
    53→        return max(counts, key=counts.get)
    54→    return None
    55→
    56→
    57→def resolve_scorecard_lang(state: dict) -> str | None:
    58→    """Best-effort current scan language key for scorecard display policy."""
    59→    return (
    60→        _lang_from_scan_history(state)
    61→        or _lang_from_capabilities(state)
    62→        or _lang_from_findings(state)
    63→    )
    64→
    65→
    66→def is_unassessed_subjective_placeholder(data: dict) -> bool:
    67→    return (
    68→        "subjective_assessment" in data.get("detectors", {})
    69→        and data.get("score", 0) == 0
    70→        and data.get("issues", 0) == 0
    71→    )
    72→
    73→
    74→def collapse_elegance_dimensions(
    75→    active_dims: list[tuple[str, dict]],
    76→    *,
    77→    lang_key: str | None,
    78→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
    79→    """Collapse High/Mid/Low elegance rows into one aggregate display row."""
    80→    component_names = set(
    81→        _ELEGANCE_COMPONENTS_BY_LANG.get(lang_key or "", _DEFAULT_ELEGANCE_COMPONENTS)
    82→    )
    83→    elegance_rows = [
    84→        (name, data) for name, data in active_dims if name in component_names
    85→    ]
    86→    if not elegance_rows:
    87→        return active_dims
    88→
    89→    remaining_rows = [
    90→        (name, data) for name, data in active_dims if name not in component_names
    91→    ]
    92→    count = len(elegance_rows)
    93→    score_avg = round(
    94→        sum(float(data.get("score", 100.0)) for _, data in elegance_rows) / count, 1
    95→    )
    96→    strict_avg = round(
    97→        sum(
    98→            float(data.get("strict", data.get("score", 100.0)))
    99→            for _, data in elegance_rows
   100→        )
   101→        / count,
   102→        1,
   103→    )
   104→    checks_total = sum(int(data.get("checks", 0)) for _, data in elegance_rows)
   105→    issues_total = sum(int(data.get("issues", 0)) for _, data in elegance_rows)
   106→    tier = max(int(data.get("tier", 4)) for _, data in elegance_rows)
   107→    placeholder_flags = [
   108→        bool(
   109→            data.get("detectors", {})
   110→            .get("subjective_assessment", {})
   111→            .get("placeholder")
   112→        )
   113→        for _, data in elegance_rows
   114→    ]
   115→
   116→    label = "Elegance"
   117→    if any(name.lower() == label.lower() for name, _ in remaining_rows):
   118→        label = "Elegance (combined)"
   119→
   120→    pass_rate = round(score_avg / 100.0, 4)
   121→    combined_entry = {
   122→        "score": score_avg,
   123→        "strict": strict_avg,
   124→        "checks": checks_total,
   125→        "issues": issues_total,
   126→        "tier": tier,
   127→        "detectors": {
   128→            "subjective_assessment": {
   129→                "potential": checks_total,
   130→                "pass_rate": pass_rate,
   131→                "issues": issues_total,
   132→                "weighted_failures": round(checks_total * (1 - pass_rate), 4),
   133→                "components": [name for name, _ in elegance_rows],
   134→            }
   135→        },
   136→    }
   137→    combined_entry["detectors"]["subjective_assessment"]["placeholder"] = any(
   138→        placeholder_flags
   139→    )
   140→    return [*remaining_rows, (label, combined_entry)]
   141→
   142→
   143→def limit_scorecard_dimensions(
   144→    active_dims: list[tuple[str, dict]],
   145→    *,
   146→    lang_key: str | None,
   147→    max_rows: int = SCORECARD_MAX_DIMENSIONS,
   148→) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
   149→    """Limit scorecard rows with language-specific subjective priority."""
   150→    if len(active_dims) <= max_rows:
   151→        return active_dims
   152→
   153→    mechanical = [
   154→        (name, data)
   155→        for name, data in active_dims
   156→        if "subjective_assessment" not in data.get("detectors", {})
   157→    ]
   158→    subjective = [
   159→        (name, data)
   160→        for name, data in active_dims
   161→        if "subjective_assessment" in data.get("detectors", {})
   162→    ]
   163→    if len(mechanical) >= max_rows:
   164→        return mechanical[:max_rows]
   165→
   166→    budget = max_rows - len(mechanical)
   167→    preferred_order = _SUBJECTIVE_SCORECARD_ORDER_BY_LANG.get(
   168→        lang_key or "",
   169→        _SUBJECTIVE_SCORECARD_ORDER_DEFAULT,
   170→    )
   171→
   172→    remaining = {name: (name, data) for name, data in subjective}
   173→    selected: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
   174→    for name in preferred_order:
   175→        row = remaining.pop(name, None)
   176→        if row is None:
   177→            continue
   178→        selected.append(row)
   179→        if len(selected) >= budget:
   180→            break
   181→
   182→    if len(selected) < budget and remaining:
   183→        extras = sorted(
   184→            remaining.values(),
   185→            key=lambda item: (
   186→                float(item[1].get("strict", item[1].get("score", 100.0))),
   187→                item[0],
   188→            ),
   189→        )
   190→        selected.extend(extras[: budget - len(selected)])
   191→
   192→    return [*mechanical, *selected]
   193→
   194→
   195→def prepare_scorecard_dimensions(state: dict) -> list[tuple[str, dict]]:
   196→    """Prepare scorecard rows (active, elegance-collapsed, capped).
   197→
   198→    Dimensions are derived dynamically from what the scoring engine produced
   199→    in ``dimension_scores`` — no per-language hard-coded dimension list.
   200→    Unassessed subjective placeholders (score 0, no issues) are excluded so
   201→    the scorecard only shows dimensions that have real data.
   202→    """
   203→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   204→    if not isinstance(dim_scores, dict):
   205→        return []
   206→
   207→    all_dims = [
   208→        (name, data) for name, data in dim_scores.items() if isinstance(data, dict)
   209→    ]
   210→
   211→    [REDACTED](state)
   212→    all_dims = collapse_elegance_dimensions(all_dims, lang_key=lang_key)
   213→
   214→    # Show dimensions with real data; skip unassessed subjective placeholders.
   215→    active_dims = [
   216→        (name, data)
   217→        for name, data in all_dims
   218→        if data.get("checks", 0) > 0 and not is_unassessed_subjective_placeholder(data)
   219→    ]
   220→    active_dims = limit_scorecard_dimensions(active_dims, lang_key=lang_key)
   221→    active_dims.sort(key=lambda x: (0 if x[0] == "File health" else 1, x[0]))
   222→    return active_dims
   223→

   197→def empty_state() -> StateModel:
   198→    """Return a new empty state payload."""
   199→    return {
   200→        "version": CURRENT_VERSION,
   201→        "created": utc_now(),
   202→        "last_scan": None,
   203→        "scan_count": 0,
   204→        "overall_score": 0,
   205→        "objective_score": 0,
   206→        "strict_score": 0,
   207→        "verified_strict_score": 0,
   208→        "stats": {},
   209→        "findings": {},
   210→        "scan_coverage": {},
   211→        "score_confidence": {},
   212→        "subjective_integrity": {},
   213→        "subjective_assessments": {},
   214→    }
   215→
   216→
   217→def _as_non_negative_int(value: Any, default: int = 0) -> int:
   218→    try:
   219→        parsed = int(value)
   220→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   221→        return default
   222→    return parsed if parsed >= 0 else 0
   223→
   224→
   225→def ensure_state_defaults(state: StateModel | dict) -> None:
   226→    """Normalize loose/legacy state payloads to a valid base shape in-place."""
   227→    for key, value in empty_state().items():
   228→        state.setdefault(key, value)
   229→
   230→    if not isinstance(state.get("findings"), dict):
   231→        state["findings"] = {}
   232→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   233→        state["stats"] = {}
   234→    if not isinstance(state.get("scan_history"), list):
   235→        state["scan_history"] = []
   236→    if not isinstance(state.get("scan_coverage"), dict):
   237→        state["scan_coverage"] = {}
   238→    if not isinstance(state.get("score_confidence"), dict):
   239→        state["score_confidence"] = {}
   240→    if not isinstance(state.get("subjective_integrity"), dict):
   241→        state["subjective_integrity"] = {}
   242→
   243→    findings = state["findings"]
   244→    to_remove: list[str] = []
   245→    for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
   246→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   247→            to_remove.append(finding_id)
   248→            continue
   249→
   250→        finding.setdefault("id", finding_id)
   251→        finding.setdefault("detector", "unknown")
   252→        finding.setdefault("file", "")
   253→        finding.setdefault("tier", 3)
   254→        finding.setdefault("confidence", "low")
   255→        finding.setdefault("summary", "")
   256→        finding.setdefault("detail", {})
   257→        finding.setdefault("status", "open")
   258→        finding["status"] = canonical_finding_status(
   259→            finding.get("status"),
   260→            default="open",
   261→        )
   262→        finding.setdefault("note", None)
   263→        finding.setdefault("first_seen", state.get("created") or utc_now())
   264→        finding.setdefault("last_seen", finding["first_seen"])
   265→        finding.setdefault("resolved_at", None)
   266→        finding["reopen_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(
   267→            finding.get("reopen_count", 0), default=0
   268→        )
   269→        finding.setdefault("suppressed", False)
   270→        finding.setdefault("suppressed_at", None)
   271→        finding.setdefault("suppression_pattern", None)
   272→
   273→    for finding_id in to_remove:
   274→        findings.pop(finding_id, None)
   275→
   276→    for entry in state["scan_history"]:
   277→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
   278→            continue
   279→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
   280→        if integrity is not None and not isinstance(integrity, dict):
   281→            entry["subjective_integrity"] = None
   282→
   283→    state["scan_count"] = _as_non_negative_int(state.get("scan_count", 0), default=0)
   284→    return None
   285→
   286→
   287→def validate_state_invariants(state: StateModel) -> None:
   288→    """Raise ValueError when core state invariants are violated."""
   289→    if not isinstance(state.get("findings"), dict):
   290→        raise ValueError("state.findings must be a dict")
   291→    if not isinstance(state.get("stats"), dict):
   292→        raise ValueError("state.stats must be a dict")
   293→
   294→    findings = state["findings"]
   295→    for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
   296→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
   297→            raise ValueError(f"finding {finding_id!r} must be a dict")
   298→        if finding.get("id") != finding_id:
   299→            raise ValueError(f"finding id mismatch for {finding_id!r}")
   300→        if finding.get("status") not in _ALLOWED_FINDING_STATUSES:
   301→            raise ValueError(
   302→                f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid status {finding.get('status')!r}"
   303→            )
   304→
   305→        tier = finding.get("tier")
   306→        if not isinstance(tier, int) or tier < 1 or tier > 4:
   307→            raise ValueError(f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid tier {tier!r}")
   308→
   309→        reopen_count = finding.get("reopen_count")
   310→        if not isinstance(reopen_count, int) or reopen_count < 0:
   311→            raise ValueError(
   312→                f"finding {finding_id!r} has invalid reopen_count {reopen_count!r}"
   313→            )
   314→
   315→

    34→def _display_fallback(dim_name: str) -> str:

    45→def _primary_lang_from_findings(findings: dict) -> str | None:

    51→        if not isinstance(raw_lang, str) or not raw_lang.strip():

    53→        key = raw_lang.strip().lower()
    54→        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1

    57→    return max(counts, key=counts.get)

   123→    """Extract component names and scores from an assessment dict."""

   147→def append_subjective_dimensions(
   148→    results: dict,
   149→    findings: dict,
   150→    assessments: dict | None,
   151→    failure_set: frozenset[str],
   152→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   153→) -> None:
   154→    """Append subjective review dimensions to results dict (mutates results).
   155→
   156→    Subjective scoring is evidence-first: open review findings for a dimension
   157→    determine pass-rate, while imported assessment scores are retained as
   158→    metadata for transparency.
   159→    """
   160→    # Deferred import to avoid circular (see _dimension_display_name).

   168→    )

   170→    default_dimensions = []
   171→    for raw_dim in raw_defaults:
   172→        dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)
   173→        if not dim:
   174→            continue
   175→        if allowed is not None and dim not in allowed:
   176→            continue
   177→        default_dimensions.append(dim)
   178→
   179→    assessed: dict[str, dict] = {}
   180→    for raw_dim, payload in (assessments or {}).items():
   181→        dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)
   182→        if not dim:
   183→            continue
   184→        # Real assessments (from review imports) always count regardless of
   185→        # allowed_dimensions — they were deliberately imported and should not
   186→        # be silently discarded.  However, system-generated placeholders
   187→        # (scan_reset_subjective) are not real assessments and should respect
   188→        # the allowed_dimensions scope like defaults.
   189→        is_placeholder = isinstance(payload, dict) and (
   190→            payload.get("placeholder") is True
   191→            or payload.get("source") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   192→            or payload.get("reset_by") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   193→        )
   194→        if is_placeholder and allowed is not None and dim not in allowed:
   195→            continue
   196→        assessed[dim] = payload

   204→
   205→    for dim_name in all_dims:

   207→        assessment = assessed.get(dim_name)
   208→        has_assessment = isinstance(assessment, dict)
   209→        if not is_default and not assessment:

   213→        if display.lower() in existing_lower:

   216→        # Count open review/concern findings for display (work queue), but

   218→        issue_count = sum(

   220→            for finding in findings.values()
   221→            if finding.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   222→            and finding.get("status") in failure_set
   223→            and _normalize_dimension_key(
   224→                finding.get("detail", {}).get("dimension")
   225→            )
   226→            == dim_name
   227→        )

   229→        score, pass_rate, assessment_score = _compute_dimension_score(
   230→            assessment, has_assessment,

   234→            and (

   236→                or assessment.get("source") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   237→                or assessment.get("placeholder") is True
   238→            )
   239→        )
   240→        components: list[str] = []
   241→        component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   242→        if isinstance(assessment, dict):

   244→
   245→        results[display] = {

   247→            "tier": 4,
   248→            "checks": SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS,
   249→            "issues": issue_count,
   250→            "detectors": {
   251→                "subjective_assessment": {
   252→                    "potential": SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS,
   253→                    "pass_rate": round(pass_rate, 4),
   254→                    "issues": issue_count,
   255→                    "weighted_failures": round(SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS * (1 - pass_rate), 4),
   256→                    "assessment_score": round(assessment_score, 1),
   257→                    "placeholder": reset_pending or not has_assessment,
   258→                    "dimension_key": dim_name,
   259→                    "configured_weight": round(

   261→                    ),
   262→                    "components": components,

   265→                        if component_scores

   267→                    ),
   268→                }
   269→            },

    40→            continue
    41→
    42→        cleaned_components: list[str] = []
    43→        components = value_obj.get("components")
    44→        if isinstance(components, list):
    45→            cleaned_components = [
    46→                str(item).strip()
    47→                for item in components
    48→                if isinstance(item, str) and item.strip()
    49→            ]
    50→
    51→        component_scores = value_obj.get("component_scores")
    52→        cleaned_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
    53→        if isinstance(component_scores, dict):
    54→            for key, raw in component_scores.items():
    55→                if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
    56→                    continue
    57→                if not is_numeric(raw):
    58→                    continue
    59→                cleaned_scores[key.strip()] = round(max(0.0, min(100.0, float(raw))), 1)
    60→
    61→        store[dimension_key] = {
    62→            "score": score,
    63→            "source": source,
    64→            "assessed_at": now,
    65→            **({"components": cleaned_components} if cleaned_components else {}),
    66→            **({"component_scores": cleaned_scores} if cleaned_scores else {}),
    67→        }
    68→

   104→def _build_dimensions() -> list[Dimension]:
   105→    """Derive dimensions from DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.
   106→
   107→    Each unique (dimension, tier) pair becomes a Dimension, with its detectors
   108→    collected automatically. Order follows first-seen in the policies dict.
   109→    """
   110→    # Collect (dimension_name -> tier) preserving first-seen order,
   111→    # and group detectors by dimension.
   112→    dim_tiers: dict[str, int] = {}
   113→    grouped: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
   114→    for detector, policy in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items():
   115→        if policy.dimension is None or policy.tier is None:
   116→            continue
   117→        if policy.dimension not in dim_tiers:
   118→            dim_tiers[policy.dimension] = policy.tier
   119→            grouped[policy.dimension] = []
   120→        grouped[policy.dimension].append(detector)
   121→    return [
   122→        Dimension(name=name, tier=tier, detectors=grouped[name])
   123→        for name, tier in dim_tiers.items()
   124→    ]
   125→
   126→

   192→# Tolerance for treating a subjective score as "on target" in integrity checks.

   194→SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE = 0.05
   195→
   196→
   197→def matches_target_score(
   198→    score: object,
   199→    target: object,
   200→    *,
   201→    tolerance: float = SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE,
   202→) -> bool:
   203→    """Return True when score is within tolerance of target."""
   204→    try:
   205→        score_value = float(score)
   206→        target_value = float(target)
   207→        tolerance_value = max(0.0, float(tolerance))
   208→    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   209→        return False
   210→    return abs(score_value - target_value) <= tolerance_value

   213→def register_scoring_policy(policy: DetectorScoringPolicy) -> None:
   214→    """Register a scoring policy at runtime (used by generic plugins)."""
   215→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES[policy.detector] = policy
   216→    _rebuild_derived()
   217→
   218→
   219→def reset_registered_scoring_policies() -> None:
   220→    """Reset runtime-added scoring policies to built-in defaults."""
   221→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.clear()
   222→    DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.update(_BASE_DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES)
   223→    _rebuild_derived()
   224→
   225→
   226→def _rebuild_derived() -> None:
   227→    """Rebuild DIMENSIONS, DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME, FILE_BASED_DETECTORS from current state.
   228→
   229→    Mutates existing objects in-place so that all references (including imports
   230→    that bound the original objects) see the updates.
   231→    """
   232→    new_dims = _build_dimensions()
   233→    DIMENSIONS.clear()
   234→    DIMENSIONS.extend(new_dims)
   235→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.clear()
   236→    DIMENSIONS_BY_NAME.update({d.name: d for d in DIMENSIONS})
   237→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.clear()
   238→    FILE_BASED_DETECTORS.update(
   239→        det for det, pol in DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.items() if pol.file_based
   240→    )
   241→

   243→def detector_policy(detector: str) -> DetectorScoringPolicy:
   244→    """Get scoring policy for a detector, with a safe default fallback."""
   245→    return DETECTOR_SCORING_POLICIES.get(
   246→        detector,
   247→        DetectorScoringPolicy(detector=detector, dimension=None, tier=None),
   248→    )

    75→def _extract_prompt_meta_impl(entry: object) -> dict[str, object]:
    76→    if not isinstance(entry, dict):

    78→    meta = entry.get("meta")
    79→    if not isinstance(meta, dict):

    91→    if isinstance(enabled, bool):

   106→def _merge_dimension_meta(
   107→    target: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
   108→    *,
   109→    dimensions: list[str],
   110→    prompts: dict[str, dict[str, object]],
   111→    override_existing: bool = False,
   112→) -> None:
   113→    """Merge one payload's prompt metadata into the shared registry."""
   114→    defaults = {
   115→        _normalize_dimension_name(dim)
   116→        for dim in dimensions
   117→        if isinstance(dim, str) and dim.strip()
   118→    }
   119→
   120→    for raw_dim, entry in prompts.items():
   121→        dim = _normalize_dimension_name(raw_dim)
   122→        if not dim:
   123→            continue
   124→
   125→        payload = target.setdefault(dim, {})
   126→        prompt_meta = _extract_prompt_meta(entry)
   127→
   128→        if "display_name" in prompt_meta and (
   129→            override_existing or "display_name" not in payload
   130→        ):
   131→            payload["display_name"] = prompt_meta["display_name"]
   132→        if "weight" in prompt_meta and (override_existing or "weight" not in payload):
   133→            payload["weight"] = prompt_meta["weight"]
   134→        if "reset_on_scan" in prompt_meta and (
   135→            override_existing or "reset_on_scan" not in payload
   136→        ):
   137→            payload["reset_on_scan"] = prompt_meta["reset_on_scan"]
   138→
   139→        if dim in defaults:
   140→            payload["enabled_by_default"] = True
   141→        if "enabled_by_default" in prompt_meta:
   142→            if override_existing:
   143→                payload["enabled_by_default"] = bool(prompt_meta["enabled_by_default"])
   144→            else:
   145→                payload["enabled_by_default"] = bool(
   146→                    payload.get("enabled_by_default", False)
   147→                    or prompt_meta["enabled_by_default"]
   148→                )

    34→def _display_fallback(dim_name: str) -> str:
    35→    words = dim_name.replace("_", " ")
    36→    return words[0].upper() + words[1:] if words else words

    39→def _normalize_dimension_key(dim_name: object) -> str:
    40→    if not isinstance(dim_name, str):
    41→        return ""
    42→    return "_".join(dim_name.strip().lower().replace("-", "_").split())
    43→
    44→
    45→def _primary_lang_from_findings(findings: dict) -> str | None:
    46→    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    47→    for finding in findings.values():
    48→        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
    49→            continue
    50→        raw_lang = finding.get("lang")
    51→        if not isinstance(raw_lang, str) or not raw_lang.strip():
    52→            continue
    53→        key = raw_lang.strip().lower()
    54→        counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
    55→    if not counts:
    56→        return None
    57→    return max(counts, key=counts.get)
    58→
    59→
    60→def _dimension_display_name(dim_name: str, *, lang_name: str | None) -> str:
    61→    try:
    62→        # Deferred import to avoid circular: scoring -> _scoring/results/core
    63→        # -> _scoring/subjective/core -> intelligence.review -> state -> scoring
    64→        from desloppify.intelligence.review.dimensions.metadata import (
    65→            dimension_display_name,
    66→        )
    67→
    68→        return str(dimension_display_name(dim_name, lang_name=lang_name))
    69→    except (ImportError, AttributeError, RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError):
    70→        return DISPLAY_NAMES.get(dim_name, _display_fallback(dim_name))
    71→
    72→
    73→def _dimension_weight(dim_name: str, *, lang_name: str | None) -> float:
    74→    try:
    75→        # Deferred import to avoid circular (see _dimension_display_name).
    76→        from desloppify.intelligence.review.dimensions.metadata import (
    77→            dimension_weight,
    78→        )
    79→
    80→        return float(dimension_weight(dim_name, lang_name=lang_name))
    81→    except (ImportError, AttributeError, RuntimeError, ValueError, TypeError):
    82→        return 1.0
    83→
    84→
    85→def _compute_dimension_score(
    86→    assessment: dict | None, has_assessment: bool,
    87→) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    88→    """Compute (score, pass_rate, assessment_score) for a dimension."""
    89→    assessment_score = (
    90→        max(0.0, min(100.0, float(assessment.get("score", 0))))
    91→        if isinstance(assessment, dict)
    92→        else 0.0
    93→    )
    94→    integrity_penalty = (
    95→        assessment.get("integrity_penalty")
    96→        if isinstance(assessment, dict)
    97→        else None
    98→    )
    99→    reset_pending = bool(
   100→        isinstance(assessment, dict)
   101→        and (
   102→            assessment.get("reset_by") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   103→            or assessment.get("source") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   104→            or assessment.get("placeholder") is True
   105→        )
   106→    )
   107→    if reset_pending:
   108→        score = 0.0
   109→        pass_rate = 0.0
   110→    elif integrity_penalty == "target_match_reset":
   111→        score = 0.0
   112→        pass_rate = 0.0
   113→    elif has_assessment:
   114→        score = assessment_score
   115→        pass_rate = score / 100.0
   116→    else:
   117→        score = 0.0
   118→        pass_rate = 0.0
   119→    return score, pass_rate, assessment_score
   120→
   121→
   122→def _extract_components(assessment: dict) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, float]]:
   123→    """Extract component names and scores from an assessment dict."""
   124→    components: list[str] = []
   125→    component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   126→    raw_components = assessment.get("components")
   127→    if isinstance(raw_components, list):
   128→        components = [
   129→            str(item).strip()
   130→            for item in raw_components
   131→            if isinstance(item, str) and item.strip()
   132→        ]
   133→    raw_component_scores = assessment.get("component_scores")
   134→    if isinstance(raw_component_scores, dict):
   135→        for key, value in raw_component_scores.items():
   136→            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
   137→                continue
   138→            if not is_numeric(value):
   139→                continue
   140→            component_scores[key.strip()] = round(
   141→                max(0.0, min(100.0, float(value))),
   142→                1,
   143→            )
   144→    return components, component_scores

   147→def append_subjective_dimensions(
   148→    results: dict,
   149→    findings: dict,
   150→    assessments: dict | None,
   151→    failure_set: frozenset[str],
   152→    allowed_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   153→) -> None:
   154→    """Append subjective review dimensions to results dict (mutates results).
   155→
   156→    Subjective scoring is evidence-first: open review findings for a dimension
   157→    determine pass-rate, while imported assessment scores are retained as
   158→    metadata for transparency.
   159→    """
   160→    # Deferred import to avoid circular (see _dimension_display_name).
   161→    from desloppify.intelligence.review.dimensions.holistic import DIMENSIONS
   162→
   163→    raw_defaults = DIMENSIONS
   164→    allowed = (
   165→        {_normalize_dimension_key(name) for name in allowed_dimensions}
   166→        if allowed_dimensions is not None
   167→        else None
   168→    )
   169→
   170→    default_dimensions = []
   171→    for raw_dim in raw_defaults:
   172→        dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)
   173→        if not dim:
   174→            continue
   175→        if allowed is not None and dim not in allowed:
   176→            continue
   177→        default_dimensions.append(dim)
   178→
   179→    assessed: dict[str, dict] = {}
   180→    for raw_dim, payload in (assessments or {}).items():
   181→        dim = _normalize_dimension_key(raw_dim)
   182→        if not dim:
   183→            continue
   184→        # Real assessments (from review imports) always count regardless of
   185→        # allowed_dimensions — they were deliberately imported and should not
   186→        # be silently discarded.  However, system-generated placeholders
   187→        # (scan_reset_subjective) are not real assessments and should respect
   188→        # the allowed_dimensions scope like defaults.
   189→        is_placeholder = isinstance(payload, dict) and (
   190→            payload.get("placeholder") is True
   191→            or payload.get("source") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   192→            or payload.get("reset_by") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   193→        )
   194→        if is_placeholder and allowed is not None and dim not in allowed:
   195→            continue
   196→        assessed[dim] = payload
   197→    existing_lower = {k.lower() for k in results}
   198→    lang_name = _primary_lang_from_findings(findings)
   199→
   200→    all_dims = list(default_dimensions)
   201→    for dim_name in assessed:
   202→        if dim_name not in default_dimensions:
   203→            all_dims.append(dim_name)
   204→
   205→    for dim_name in all_dims:
   206→        is_default = dim_name in default_dimensions
   207→        assessment = assessed.get(dim_name)
   208→        has_assessment = isinstance(assessment, dict)
   209→        if not is_default and not assessment:
   210→            continue
   211→
   212→        display = _dimension_display_name(dim_name, lang_name=lang_name)
   213→        if display.lower() in existing_lower:
   214→            display = f"{display} (subjective)"
   215→
   216→        # Count open review/concern findings for display (work queue), but
   217→        # these do NOT drive the dimension score — only assessment scores do.
   218→        issue_count = sum(
   219→            1
   220→            for finding in findings.values()
   221→            if finding.get("detector") in ("review", "concerns")
   222→            and finding.get("status") in failure_set
   223→            and _normalize_dimension_key(
   224→                finding.get("detail", {}).get("dimension")
   225→            )
   226→            == dim_name
   227→        )
   228→
   229→        score, pass_rate, assessment_score = _compute_dimension_score(
   230→            assessment, has_assessment,
   231→        )
   232→        reset_pending = bool(
   233→            isinstance(assessment, dict)
   234→            and (
   235→                assessment.get("reset_by") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   236→                or assessment.get("source") == "scan_reset_subjective"
   237→                or assessment.get("placeholder") is True
   238→            )
   239→        )
   240→        components: list[str] = []
   241→        component_scores: dict[str, float] = {}
   242→        if isinstance(assessment, dict):
   243→            components, component_scores = _extract_components(assessment)
   244→
   245→        results[display] = {
   246→            "score": round(float(score), 1),
   247→            "tier": 4,
   248→            "checks": SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS,
   249→            "issues": issue_count,
   250→            "detectors": {
   251→                "subjective_assessment": {
   252→                    "potential": SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS,
   253→                    "pass_rate": round(pass_rate, 4),
   254→                    "issues": issue_count,
   255→                    "weighted_failures": round(SUBJECTIVE_CHECKS * (1 - pass_rate), 4),
   256→                    "assessment_score": round(assessment_score, 1),
   257→                    "placeholder": reset_pending or not has_assessment,
   258→                    "dimension_key": dim_name,
   259→                    "configured_weight": round(
   260→                        _dimension_weight(dim_name, lang_name=lang_name), 6
   261→                    ),
   262→                    "components": components,
   263→                    **(
   264→                        {"component_scores": component_scores}
   265→                        if component_scores
   266→                        else {}
   267→                    ),
   268→                }
   269→            },
   270→        }

   275→    "append_subjective_dimensions",

1→"""Lightweight integrity helpers for subjective/review scoring.
     2→
     3→This module intentionally lives outside ``desloppify.intelligence.review`` so command/state
     4→paths can import it without loading the heavier review package.
     5→"""
     6→
     7→from __future__ import annotations
     8→
     9→from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
    10→
    11→from desloppify.scoring import (
    12→    SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE,
    13→    matches_target_score,
    14→)
    15→
    16→__all__ = [
    17→    "SUBJECTIVE_TARGET_MATCH_TOLERANCE",
    18→    "is_holistic_subjective_finding",
    19→    "is_subjective_review_open",
    20→    "matches_target_score",
    21→    "subjective_review_open_breakdown",
    22→    "unassessed_subjective_dimensions",
    23→]
    24→
    25→
    26→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27→# Internal iteration helper
    28→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    29→
    30→
    31→def _iter_findings(
    32→    findings: Mapping[str, dict] | Iterable[dict],
    33→) -> Iterable[tuple[str, dict]]:
    34→    """Yield (finding_id, finding) pairs from mapping or iterable inputs."""
    35→    if isinstance(findings, Mapping):
    36→        for finding_id, finding in findings.items():
    37→            if isinstance(finding, dict):
    38→                yield str(finding_id), finding
    39→        return
    40→
    41→    for index, finding in enumerate(findings):
    42→        if isinstance(finding, dict):
    43→            yield str(index), finding
    44→
    45→
    46→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    47→# Public helpers (formerly in integrity/review.py)
    48→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    49→
    50→
    51→def is_subjective_review_open(finding: dict) -> bool:
    52→    """Return True when a finding is an open subjective-review signal."""
    53→    return (
    54→        finding.get("status") == "open"
    55→        and finding.get("detector") == "subjective_review"
    56→    )
    57→
    58→
    59→def is_holistic_subjective_finding(finding: dict, *, finding_id: str = "") -> bool:
    60→    """Best-effort check for holistic subjective-review coverage findings."""
    61→    candidate_id = str(finding.get("id") or finding_id or "")
    62→    if "::holistic_unreviewed" in candidate_id or "::holistic_stale" in candidate_id:
    63→        return True
    64→
    65→    summary = str(finding.get("summary", "") or "").lower()
    66→    if "holistic" in summary and "review" in summary:
    67→        return True
    68→
    69→    detail = finding.get("detail", {})
    70→    return bool(detail.get("holistic"))
    71→
    72→
    73→def subjective_review_open_breakdown(
    74→    findings: Mapping[str, dict] | Iterable[dict],
    75→) -> tuple[int, dict[str, int], dict[str, int]]:
    76→    """Return open subjective count plus reason and holistic-reason breakdowns."""
    77→    reason_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    78→    holistic_reason_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    79→    total = 0
    80→
    81→    for finding_id, finding in _iter_findings(findings):
    82→        if not is_subjective_review_open(finding):
    83→            continue
    84→
    85→        total += 1
    86→        reason = str(finding.get("detail", {}).get("reason", "other") or "other")
    87→        reason_counts[reason] = reason_counts.get(reason, 0) + 1
    88→
    89→        if is_holistic_subjective_finding(finding, finding_id=finding_id):
    90→            holistic_reason_counts[reason] = holistic_reason_counts.get(reason, 0) + 1
    91→
    92→    return total, reason_counts, holistic_reason_counts
    93→
    94→
    95→def unassessed_subjective_dimensions(dim_scores: dict | None) -> list[str]:
    96→    """Return subjective dimension display names that are still 0% placeholders."""
    97→    if not dim_scores:
    98→        return []
    99→
   100→    unassessed: list[str] = []
   101→    for name, info in dim_scores.items():
   102→        detectors = info.get("detectors", {})
   103→        if "subjective_assessment" not in detectors:
   104→            continue
   105→        assessment_meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment", {})
   106→        if isinstance(assessment_meta, dict) and assessment_meta.get("placeholder"):
   107→            unassessed.append(name)
   108→            continue
   109→        strict_val = float(info.get("strict", info.get("score", 100.0)))
   110→        issues = int(info.get("issues", 0))
   111→        if strict_val <= 0.0 and issues == 0:
   112→            unassessed.append(name)
   113→
   114→    unassessed.sort()
   115→    return unassessed
   116→

     5→from desloppify.app.output.scorecard_parts.dimension_policy import (
